Cards like {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods} and {TB1-097 Son Goku, The Awakened Power} have skills that say “[Permanent] This card's attack and skill cannot be negated,” but those skills are only active when those cards are in the Battle Area. qa.q: This card has been activated in your Battle Area, and your opponent uses {BT6-126 Arcane Absorption Majin Buu}'s activate skill, choosing {BT6-047 Babidi, Overseer of Destruction} for its skill cost. Does {BT6-126 Arcane Absorption Majin Buu} get placed in their energy?

Yes, it does.
If the 〈Evil Wizard Babidi〉 card they play using {BT6-126 Arcane Absorption Majin Buu}’s activate skill has an energy cost of 3 or less, they play it, then {BT6-126 Arcane Absorption Majin Buu} is placed in their energy.
If the 〈Evil Wizard Babidi〉 card they play using {BT6-126 Arcane Absorption Majin Buu}’s activate skill has an energy cost of 4 or more, it is placed in their energy and {BT6-126 Arcane Absorption Majin Buu} remains in their hand, unplayed.

qa.q: If an attack from one of your cards causes an opponent to add a card from their life to their hand, does this card’s auto skill activate?
qa.a: No, it doesn’t.

qa.a: Yes, it does.

qa.a: No, it doesn’t. [Strike] skills only modify the amount of damage dealt to your opponent from attacks. Your opponent isn’t losing life to a skill, so the auto skill on this card doesn’t activate.

qa.q: If you use this card's [Permanent] skill to activate [Union-Potara] and play this card on top of a {SD7-03 Vegeta, Returned from Darkness} in your energy, does {SD7-03 Vegeta, Returned from Darkness}'s [Auto] skill activate?

qa.q: You use this card's auto skill and declare 〈Evil Wizard Babidi〉 cards with energy costs of 1. During your opponent's next turn, they choose {BT6-047 Babidi, Overseer of Destruction} as the skill cost for {BT6-126 Arcane Absorption Majin Buu}'s activate skill. Is {BT6-126 Arcane Absorption Majin Buu} played?
qa.a: No, it isn't. {BT6-126 Arcane Absorption Majin Buu}'s activate skill plays itself on top of an 〈Evil Wizard Babidi〉 card they also play with its skill. They won't be able to play the 〈Evil Wizard Babidi〉 card, so they can't play {BT6-126 Arcane Absorption Majin Buu} and it stays in their hand.

You then use this card's auto skill to declare 〈Hit〉 cards with energy costs of 3. Does {TB1-009 Dimension Leaper Hit} play itself at the start of your opponent's next turn?

qa.q: Can I declare any card or energy card with this card’s Auto skill?
qa.a: Players can only declare energy costs and character names that actually exist in DBSCG.

qa.q: Where can I find the card’s character name?
qa.a: Character names are found on the bottom right of cards marked "Character."

qa.q: Can I declare a type of token or token name?
qa.a: No, tokens and token names cannot be declared.

qa.q: At an event, what language can I declare the character name in?
qa.a: Character names should be stated in the primary language of the event.

qa.q: What happens if my opponent and I cannot properly pronounce or misunderstand the pronunciation of a character’s name?
qa.a: Declarations should be as specific as possible. Players should strive to make sure there are no misunderstandings about the declared information. After a declaration, both players should confirm with one another that they both understand which information was declared.

qa.q: When you have this card in play, are the skills of your opponent's Battle Cards with [Barrier] negated?
qa.a: Yes, they are.

qa.q: If your opponent has {DB1-066 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} in play in their Battle Area and you play this card, are your opponent's skills negated?
qa.a: No, they aren't. The permanent skill of your opponent's {DB1-066 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} takes effect, negating the skills on your cards (including this one).

qa.q: If you have this card in play in your Battle Area and you use {P-069 Miracle Strike Gogeta}'s skill to negate your opponent's {DB1-066 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler}'s skill, will the skill of your opponent's {DB1-066 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} come back into effect during the End Phase?
qa.a: No, it won't. Once your opponent's {DB1-066 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler}'s skill is negated, this card's skill comes into effect. Even when {P-069 Miracle Strike Gogeta}'s skill wears off, {DB1-066 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler}'s skill will remain negated.

qa.q: When this card is in play, will Battle Cards played using [Over Realm] still be sent to their owners’ Warps at the end of the turn?
qa.a: Yes, they will. The Battle Card's skills will be negated, but [Over Realm] was activated and resolved, so the cards are still sent to their owners’ Warps.

qa.q: When this card is in play and {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods} is played, are {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods}'s skills negated?
qa.a: No, they aren’t.

qa.q: When this card is in play and there are Shadow Tokens in play with [Blocker] that were created by the permanent skill of {BT7-046 Mass Replication}, are the skills of those Shadow Tokens negated?
qa.a: Yes, they are.

qa.q: This card is in play and your opponent activates {TB3-048 Preemptive Strike} in response to a Battle Card with an energy cost of 4 or less being played. If the Battle Card being played has [Deflect], is that card affected by {TB3-048 Preemptive Strike}'s [Counter : Play] skill?
qa.a: No, it isn't. {TB3-048 Preemptive Strike} is used during Counter Window 1, before the Battle Card is played, so the Battle Card still has [Deflect].

qa.q: This card is in play and your opponent activates {DB1-020 Galick Cannon} in response to a Battle Card being played. If the Battle Card being played has [Deflect], is that card affected by {DB1-020 Galick Cannon}'s [Counter : Play] skill?
qa.a: Yes, it is. {DB1-020 Galick Cannon} is used during Counter Window 2, so the Battle Card is already played. This card's permanent skill negates the Battle Card's [Deflect], and the Battle Card is affected by {DB1-020 Galick Cannon}'s [Counter : Play] skill.

qa.q: If you have this card and {BT6-047 Babidi, Overseer of Destruction} in play, can you gain control of another copy of {BT6-047 Babidi, Overseer of Destruction} using {BT3-029 Baby's Subdual}?
qa.a: Yes, you can. The [Permanent] skill on both players' copies of {BT6-047 Babidi, Overseer of Destruction} is negated, so you can have more than one copy in play.

qa.q: If your opponent uses a skill to gain control of this card, can they activate and resolve this card’s auto skill?
qa.a: Yes, it activates. The master of the Battle Area prior to the card changing control becomes the master of this skill, and activates and resolves it.

qa.q: Can you add this card to your hand using {BT3-105 Planet Vegeta}’s auto skill?
qa.a: No, you can’t.

qa.q: If your opponent activates the [Counter : Play] skill on {BT10-044 SS Trunks, God-Sealing Technique} in response to this card’s activate skill, how would things resolve?
qa.a: Because of {BT10-044 SS Trunks, God-Sealing Technique}’s [Counter : Play] skill, {BT10-154 SS4 Gogeta, Peerless Fusion} is not played. However, Gogeta’s controller would still draw 2 cards and switch up to 2 of their energy to Active Mode, and their opponent would choose 2 of their Battle Card and 2 cards in their hand and send them to their owners’ Warps.

qa.q: If the only cards in your energy are 5 Red/Blue multicolor cards, can you play this card with its activate skill?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.a: No, you can’t.

qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.a: Yes, it does.

qa.q: If you use this card’s auto skill to reduce the power of an opponent’s Unison Card with 2 or more markers on it to zero, is that Unison Card placed in its owner’s Drop Area?
qa.a: No, it doesn’t. The Unison Card loses 1 marker, and any continuous effects on the card—including those modifying the card's power—are reverted.

qa.q: If the card your opponent sends to their Warp from their hand with this card’s auto skill moves to a different area, do they still add it to their hand at the end of their next turn?
qa.a: No, they don’t.

qa.a: No, they don’t.

qa.a: No, it can’t. In the upper right corner, “LEADER FRONT” designates the front side of the card and “LEADER BACK” designates the back side.

qa.a: Yes, it does.

qa.q: Is a card with this card on top of it in Rest Mode switched to Active Mode during its controller’s Charge Phase?
qa.a:
Yes, it is.
All Rest Mode cards in a player’s Battle Area are switched to Active Mode during their Charge Phase.

qa.q: When this card in Active Mode is moved from the Battle Area leaving the card it was placed on behind, what happens to the position of the card left in the Battle Area?
qa.a:
It is left in the Battle Area in Active Mode.
When the top card of a stack of cards is removed from that stack, the remaining cards retain the position the top card was in.

qa.q: When a copy of this card you activated is placed in the Drop Area from the opponent’s Battle Area, in which player’s Drop Area is it placed?
qa.a: It’s placed in your Drop Area.

qa.q: The opponent attacked with a Battle Card which has 15000 power. The condition for the auto skill of the opponent’s leader, {BT01-001 Champa} has been fulfilled but you activated this card before it resolved. Can the opponent draw a card with {BT01-001 Champa}’s auto skill?
qa.a:
No, they cannot.
Since the card is not at 15000 power at the time the skill resolves, the auto skill doesn’t activate.

qa.q: Is a copy of this card on a Battle Card considered a card in the Battle Area?
qa.a: Yes, it is. The whole stack is treated as 1 card.

qa.q: Can you choose a copy of this card on top of one of your Battle Cards as the card you place in the Drop Area due to {BT1-057 Broly, The Legendary Super Saiyan}’s auto skill ?
qa.a:
Yes, you can.
In that case, the whole stack of cards is placed in the Drop Area.

qa.q: If you place a {BT1-078 Overflowing Bio Warrior Army} with a copy of this card stacked on top of it in the Drop Area due to {BT1-057 Broly, The Legendary Super Saiyan}’s auto skill, does the Bio Warrior Army’s auto skill activate?
qa.a:
No, it does not.
As long as this card is on a Battle Card, all the card’s information is negated. This means that it is placed in the Drop Area as a negated card, thus the auto skill does not activate.

qa.q: When you attacked with {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods}, the opponent activated this card. How does the battle play out?
qa.a:
The battle ends.
The attack of {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods} is not negated, yet as {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods} has been overwritten by this card, a Battle Card has left the battle, thus ending it.

qa.q: When you attacked with a Ghost Token, the opponent activated this card. What happens?
qa.a:
The Ghost Token’s attack is negated, and this card is placed on it.
This card is placed in its owner’s Drop Area at the end of the opponent's next turn. The token remains in the same position as it was when this card was placed on top of it.

qa.q: When you attack with a Battle Card which has the [Indestructible] skill, the opponent activates this card. What happens?
qa.a: After the Battle Card’s attack is negated, place this card on top of the Battle Card with [Indestructible].

qa.q: Is the ＜Paikuhan＞ card referred to in this card’s auto skill a ＜Paikuhan＞ card in your Battle Area?
qa.a: Yes, it is.

qa.q: If you can’t place 1 ＜Son Goku＞ card and 1 ＜Vegeta＞ card in your Drop Area using this card’s activate skill, does this card remain in your hand after you pay the energy cost?
qa.a: No, you can’t even pay the energy cost, since you can’t pay all of the costs required to activate the skill. If you look in your deck and can’t place 1 of each card in your Drop Area, you shuffle your deck, the skill fails to resolve.

qa.q: If you attack {BT10-064 Demigra, Unison of Sorcery} and would remove a marker from it, if your opponent would use its permanent skill to add a card from their life to their hand, do you get to choose the card they add to their hand?
qa.a: No, you don’t.

qa.q: If you attack and deal damage to {BT12-086 Frieza}, if your opponent would use its permanent skill to flip a card in their life face up, do you get to choose the card they flip?
qa.a: No, you don’t.

qa.a: Yes, you do. If you play this card, the Unison Card already in play is placed in its owner’s Drop Area.

qa.q: Do you choose the card in your opponent’s life that is flipped face up by this card’s activate skill?
qa.a: Yes, you do.

qa.q: Can you choose {BT12-057 King Piccolo, Dimensional Conqueror} with this card’s auto skill if it has its skills negated?
qa.a: Yes, you can. Even if it has its skills negated, the card’s skill text doesn’t change.

qa.q: Does the card flipped face up by this skill in your opponent’s life get flipped face down at the end of your opponent’s turn?
qa.a: No. It stays face up.

qa.q: Do you choose the card in your opponent’s life that is flipped face up by this card’s activate skill?
qa.a: Yes, you do.

qa.q: This card’s [Counter : Attack] skill reads, “For each card color among cards in Battle Areas and Energy Areas” – What does this mean, exactly? For example, let’s say there are red/blue and red/green cards in your Energy Area, red and blue/green cards in your Battle Area, green/yellow and yellow/black cards in your opponent’s Energy Area, and green, yellow, and black cards in your opponent’s Battle Area. How many different card colors are considered to be in play?
qa.a: Five.

qa.q: This card’s [Awaken] skill refers to you having “4 or more colors in your energy” -- what does this require, exactly?
qa.a: It requires you to have 4 or more unique colors in your energy. For example, if you have red, blue, green, and yellow cards in your energy, this would meet the requirements to Awaken. Multi-color cards provide 2 unique colors.

qa.q: You use this card’s [Auto] skill to choose an opponent’s Battle Card with 30000 power and give it -15000 power. Later that same turn, you use a different card’s effect to give that same card an addition -15000 power, reducing its power to 0. Can you draw 1 card off this card’s effect?

qa.q: This card is placed in your Drop Area the same turn you played it. At the end of the turn, can you use this card’s [Auto] skill to draw 1 card and switch the chosen card to Active Mode?

qa.q: This card is placed in your Drop Area the same turn you played it. At the end of the turn, can you use this card’s [Auto] skill to draw 1 card and switch the chosen card to Active Mode?

qa.q: This card’s [Permanent] skill refers to have “4 or more colors among cards in your energy and Battle Area” -- what does this require, exactly?
qa.a: It requires you to have 4 or more unique colors in your energy and Battle area combined. For example, if you have 1 red/blue card in your Battle Area, and 1 green/yellow card in your energy, this would meet the requirements. Multi-color cards provide 2 unique colors.

An opponent's red Saiyan with a power of 20001 or more is already affecting this card, but if that card's power is reduced to 20000 or less, can it still affect this card?

It depends on the activation order of the combo'd ＜Android 13＞ card's [Auto] skill and [Dual Attack].
If you activate [Dual Attack] first, this card can attack 1 more time. If you use the ＜Android 13＞ card in a combo first, [Dual Attack] no longer applies and doesn't activate.

No, you cannot.

qa.q: The attack of a card with [Triple Attack] was negated. Can it be switched to Active Mode with [Triple Attack]?
qa.a:
Yes, it can.
Even if the attack is negated, skills which are processed at the end of a battle are resolved, and thus you can switch the card to Active Mode.

qa.q: Can you include a total of 2 or more cards with [Ultimate] in your deck if they’re split between your deck and side deck?
qa.a:
No, you can’t.
You can only include a total of 1 card with [Ultimate] combined between your deck and side deck.

qa.q: When I use this card’s [Auto][Once per turn] skill to choose 1 of my opponent’s Battle Cards, can I choose the same card multiple times?
qa.a: No, you can’t.

qa.q: If I use this card’s [Activate : Main] effect to place cards under a card played by this card, what happens to the cards that are under this card?
qa.a: All of the cards under this card are also placed under the played card.

qa.q: Can I use this card’s [Activate : Main] effect to place Z-Battle Cards from under this card in their owner’s Drop?
qa.a: No, you can’t place it in a Drop because Z-Cards are removed from the game instead of being placed in a Drop. Therefore, the skill cost isn’t fulfilled and you can’t pay it, so you can’t use Z-Cards to pay the skill cost.

qa.q: When this card attacks, my opponent activated [Counter : Attack] and that skill reduced my opponent’s life to 3 or less. Does this card’s [Auto] skill activate and deal damage to my opponent?
qa.a: No, it doesn’t activate because the skill cost isn’t fulfilled at the checkpoint.

qa.q: What does the second [Permanent] skill’s “you can use your ＜Android 21＞ Z-Battle Cards and your opponent's Battle Cards and Unisons as energy” mean?
qa.a: By switching your opponent’s Active Mode Battle Cards or Unisons to Rest Mode, you can use those cards for your own energy. This is only treated as energy when paying the energy cost for ＜Android 21＞ cards. Additionally, these cards don’t count toward the permanent energy count, and they can’t be chosen for skills that include text such as “switch energy to Rest Mode.”

qa.q: When I use this card’s second [Permanent] skill to use my opponent’s cards as energy, can I ignore [Barrier]?
qa.a: Yes, you can. You are not choosing cards, so [Barrier] does not affect this effect.

qa.q: When I use this card’s second [Permanent] skill to use my opponent’s cards as energy, does that energy have a color?
qa.a: Yes, it does. A blue Battle Card is treated as 1 blue energy.

qa.q: Can I use this card’s [Z-Stack 2] to place 2 ＜Krillin＞ cards under this card?
qa.a: No, you can’t. ＜Krillin＞ and ＜Android 17＞ cards are specified, so you can place 1 of each for a total of up to 2 cards under this card.

qa.q: Can I use this card’s [Activate : Main] skill to place a Z-Battle Card from under this card in its owner’s Drop?

qa.q: If this card’s [Auto] effect activates, what happens to a Z-Leader that was placed on top of this card?
qa.a: It will be placed under this card.

qa.a: Yes, all keyword skills that have “Strike” in their name will be negated.

qa.q: If I use my opponent’s Battle Cards in a combo and add them to Z-Energy, are those cards added to my Z-Energy or my opponent’s Z-Energy?
qa.a: They are added to your opponent’s Z-Energy.

qa.q: Can I use this card’s [Activate : Battle] skill to use an opponent’s Z-Battle Card without a combo cost or combo power in a combo?
qa.a: No, you can’t. Cards without a combo cost or combo power can’t be used in a combo.

qa.q: Which player draws a card for this card’s [Auto] skill?
qa.a: That player that is the master of the Battle Area where this card was played draws the card.

qa.q: What does “using [Overlord] to choose your opponent’s Battle Cards” mean?
qa.a: It means that when you would place one of your Battle Cards at the bottom of your deck as the skill cost, you may also choose one of your opponent’s Battle Cards.

qa.q: In which areas is this card’s first [Permanent] skill active?
qa.a: It is active for {BT21-032 Power Pole} in all of your areas.

qa.q: If you use this card’s [Activate : Main] skill to activate the specified card’s [Activate : Main] skill, when does the specified card’s [Activate : Main] skill activate?
qa.a: The specified card’s [Activate : Main] skill activates and resolves while this card’s [Activate : Main] skill is resolving.

qa.q: If you use this card’s [Activate : Main] skill to activate an [Activate : Main] skill that has an effect that plays a Battle Card, how exactly does a [Counter : Play] skill activate?
qa.a: A [Counter : Play] skill can be activated in response to a skill that has an effect that plays a card, even though this card’s [Activate : Main] skill is still resolving.

qa.q: Your opponent activates a [Counter : Play] skill for some reason in response to this card’s first [Auto] skill, then a “place it in its owner’s Drop instead” effect is resolved. If this card’s [Permanent] skill is active, is this card placed in your opponent’s Drop?
qa.a: Yes, it is.

qa.q: In which areas does this card’s first [Activate : Main] skill activate?
qa.a: It activates from your hand.

qa.q: After this card’s second [Activate : Main] skill activates, do you place this card in your Drop?
qa.a: No, you don’t.

qa.q: Does this card’s [Auto] skill activate twice at “When this card attacks” and “at the beginning of that battle’s Damage Step”?
qa.a: No, it only activates once when this card attacks. The activated effect is resolved when the specified “at the beginning of that battle’s Damage Step” timing occurs.

qa.q: When is “at the beginning of that battle’s Damage Step”?
qa.a: It is after the non-turn player uses a combo or performs an action like activating an [Activate : Battle] skill and then declares they won’t perform any other actions in response to the turn player’s attack, but before adding the combo power of cards in the Combo Area to attack cards and guard cards.

qa.q: If your opponent uses a combo, can you draw 1 additional card using this card’s [Auto] skill even if this card is attacking a Leader?
qa.a: Yes, you can draw 1 additional card before the beginning of the damage step as long as there are no cards in your opponent’s Combo Area.

qa.q: If you use this card’s first [Auto] skill to resolve “choose up to a total of 3 Battle Cards in your opponent’s Battle Area or Drop,” can you choose a total of 3 Battle Cards from both your opponent’s Battle Area and Drop, such as choosing 2 cards from the Battle Area and 1 area from the Drop?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.a: Yes, it is.

qa.q: Which player’s Battle Area does ”When a card in the Battle Area is placed at the bottom of a deck” refer to in this card’s second [Auto] skill?
qa.a: It refers to a card in either player’s Battle Area.

qa.q: If a continuing effect such as a “for the turn” effect is valid when this card’s [Auto] skill activates, what happens to that effect?

qa.q: Your opponent played a Battle Card during their turn. Can you choose to not negate that card’s skills using this card’s second [Auto] skill, and then negate the skills of the next Battle Card that your opponent plays?

qa.q: Your opponent used a [Counter : Play] effect to play a Battle Card during your turn. Can you use this card’s second [Auto] skill to negate an [Auto] skill that uses that card’s “when this card is played” as its trigger condition?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: Your life was placed in your Drop while this card was in your hand. If you choose to not activate this card’s [Auto] skill, do you have to declare that choice?

qa.q: You activated this card’s [Auto] skill when your opponent had 1 card in their Warp. This skill’s effect sends 1 of your opponent’s Battle Cards to their Warp, so your opponent now has 2 cards in their Warp. Can you use this card’s effect to draw 1 card?

qa.q: You activated this card’s [Activate : Battle] skill during a battle in which your opponent’s Battle Card or Unison attacked. Can you use this skill’s effect to choose 1 of your cards and give it +10000 power for the battle?

qa.q: Are there rules for the numbers you can declare for this card's [Auto] skill?
qa.a: Yes. When choosing a number in the game, unless specified otherwise, the player must choose a whole number that is zero or greater.

qa.q: If the card revealed by this card's [Auto] skill is a Unison Card that shows X for its energy cost, what is the energy cost considered to be for the revealed card?
qa.a: If an energy cost is X, unless specified otherwise, it's considered to be 0 except when paying the energy cost. In addition, if the specified cost is greater than the energy cost, the specified cost value will become the energy cost value, therefore the energy cost of the revealed card will be considered to be the same as its specified cost.

qa.q: If you only choose 1 card from your Warp for this card's [Auto] skill, can you choose to not add 1 card from your hand and use the effect to place that card at the bottom of your deck?
qa.a: No, you can't.

BT22-137.name: SS Gogeta, Light Shining Through Hell

qa.q: If this card's power is reduced to zero by an opponent's skill when it can't be removed from your Battle Area, is it placed in your Drop?
qa.a: Yes, it is.

qa.q: What does "exactly the same color and character name" mean, exactly?
qa.a:
An example of cards you can stack would be the {BT22-001 Son Gohan, Unfaltering Power} Leader Card's back side and the {BT22-003 Son Gohan, Awakening to Beast} Z-Leader with 20000 power, since both cards are red ＜Son Gohan : SH＞ cards.
An example of cards you can't stack would be the {SS Son Goku, SS Vegeta, & SS Trunks, the Ultimate Team} Leader Card's back side and the {SS Son Goku, United Onslaught} Z-Leader with 15000 power, since one card is a red ＜Son Goku/Vegeta/Trunks: Future＞ card and the other card is a red ＜Son Goku＞-only card.

qa.q: Do you have to pay the Z-Leader's Z-Energy cost when stacking a Z-Leader?
qa.a: No, you don't.

BT22-139.name: Great Ape Cumber, Golden Wickedness Amplified

qa.q: When you use one of your cards with the [Victory Strike] skill to deal damage to your opponent, can you win the game with [Victory Strike] if your opponent doesn’t take damage by this card's [Permanent] skill?
qa.a: No, you can't. When dealing damage by [Victory Strike], you win the game. However, this card's skill prevents damage from being dealt, so you can't win the game.

qa.q: When you would add your life to your hand by a skill, can you choose to not add life if you don't take damage by this card's [Permanent] skill?
qa.a: No, you can't. Effects and costs that add life aren't damage, therefore you must add the life.

qa.q: When using this card's [Activate : Main] skill to remove 2 cards in your Z-Deck from the game, can you remove face-up cards in your Z-Deck from the game?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: If you activate this card's [Aegis] skill when the [Permanent] skill is active, which player chooses the card to send from your opponent’s hand to the bottom of their deck?
qa.a: The master of this card places 1 card from the hand of their opponent at the bottom of their deck.

qa.q: What does the "remove only this card on top of a card in the Battle Area from the game" skill cost for this card's [Auto] skill mean, exactly?
qa.a: It means that if this card is placed in the Battle Area and another card is under it, you only remove this card from the game and leave the card that was under it in the Battle Area.

qa.q: Is the power of the attacking card its current power?
qa.a: Yes, it's the power at the time of the respective card's attack. If its power has been modified, you reference the power after it was modified.

qa.q: You activated this card's [Blocker] skill and your life became 6 during a battle. If you flip this card over using this card's 2nd [Auto] skill, is the guard card the Leader?
qa.a: Yes, the guard card is the Leader.

qa.q: How long are the cards in their hand revealed?
qa.a: They are revealed until this skill's effect processing is complete.

qa.q: Does the "declared number" in this card's [Auto] skill have to be the number declared for this skill?
qa.a: Yes.

qa.q: If this card is played in your Battle Area, does this card's 2nd [Auto] skill activate when your opponent plays a Battle Card in your Battle Area?
qa.a: Yes, it activates.

qa.q: If this card is played in your Battle Area, does this card's 2nd [Auto] skill activate when you play a Battle Card in your opponent's Battle Area?
qa.a: No, it doesn't activate.

qa.q: You used 2 copies of this card and gave the [Auto] skill to 1 Battle Card twice. When that Battle Card attacks, do both of the [Auto] skills given to it by this card activate?
qa.a: Yes, it activates a total of 2 times.

qa.q: Your Leader is {BT23-099 Son Goku, Autonomous Awakening} and you have 1 each of this card, {BT23-116 Piccolo, Assistance From Goku}, and {BT23-118 Android 17, Assistance From Goku} in your Combo Area. After the battle is over, these 3 cards are added to Z-Energy, but can each of these 3 cards' [Auto] skills activate?
qa.a: No, they can't. After the battle is over, when you add 1 of those cards to Z-Energy, you can activate that card's [Auto] skill. However, when the cards in your Combo Area would be placed in your Drop, if you use your Leader's [Permanent] skill to add them to Z-Energy instead, the "have a 《Universe 7》 card in your Combo Area" skill cost for the [Auto] skill isn't met at the time of the next checkpoint, therefore it can't activate.

qa.q: If you choose a ＜Kale＞ card in your Battle Area and a ＜Caulifla＞ card in your Combo Area for this card's [Activate] skill, and then one of them is placed in its owner's Drop before this card is played, can you play this card?
qa.a: Yes, you can. The skill cost only includes up to the act of choosing a ＜Kale＞ card in your Battle Area and a ＜Caulifla＞ card in your Combo Area. Even if a chosen card is later moved to a different area, when you play this card, one of the chosen cards that hasn't moved is placed under it.

BT23-133.name: Fused Zamasu, the Beginning of Destruction

qa.q: Can you choose a ＜Goku Black＞ Z-Battle Card for the skill cost for activating this card's [Activate : Main] skill?
qa.a: No, you can't. When a Z-Battle Card would be removed from the Battle Area, it's removed from the game instead, therefore it can't be placed at the bottom of your deck for the skill cost.

qa.q: If you attack with this card, your opponent uses {BT11-054 Vegeta, Disciplined Warrior} in a combo, and both players activate [Auto] on their respective cards, what happens to the combo power of the card that was used in that combo?
qa.a: It becomes 0. The combo power becomes 0 during that battle due to {BT23-138 SS Trunks, Complete Elimination}'s skill, and this remains unchanged.

BT23-140.name: Ultra Instinct Son Goku, State of the Gods

qa.q: Your opponent activated [Counter : Attack] on {P-442 Android 17, Defending Friends} from their hand in response to this card's attack. Is this card's attack negated in cases where this card's 1st [Permanent] skill applies?
qa.a: Yes, it's negated.

qa.q: This card is played in your opponent's Battle Area in a state where this card's 2nd [Permanent] skill applies. When you activate {BT10-119 Negative Energy One-Star Ball}'s [Activate : Main] skill, do you have to switch 2 of your cards to Rest Mode?
qa.a: Yes. You must pay (Y) for [Activate : Main]'s skill cost and switch 2 Active Mode cards to Rest Mode.

qa.q: If the situation is the same as in Q2, can you pay (Y) and place {BT10-119 Negative Energy One-Star Ball} in its owner's Drop after switching 2 cards including {BT10-119 Negative Energy One-Star Ball} itself to Rest Mode when switching Active Mode cards to Rest Mode?
qa.a: No, you can't. If a skill cost is added, the full cost must be paid.

qa.q: Can you treat 1 single Battle Card with 2 of the target character names such as ＜Son Goten＞ and ＜Trunks : Youth＞ as 2 cards?
qa.a: No, you can't. You must choose a total of 5 individual cards.

BT24-008.name: Son Goku, For the Sake of His Son

qa.q: Can you use this [Activate] skill to play this card even if you don't have {Power Pole} in your Drop?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: If this card has activated its [Auto] skill and is then moved from the Battle Area to another area at the end of the battle, can you add it to Z-Energy?
qa.a: No, you can't.

qa.q: If this card has activated its [Auto] skill and is then moved from the Battle Area to another area at the end of the battle, can you add it to Z-Energy?
qa.a: No, you can't.

qa.q: If this card has activated its [Auto] skill and is then moved from the Battle Area to another area at the end of the battle, can you add it to Z-Energy?
qa.a: No, you can't.

BT24-025.name: Tapion, Hero Revived in the Present

qa.q: Which comes first, the start of the Battle End Step or the timing for adding cards used in a combo to Z-Energy?
qa.a: The Battle End Step comes first.

qa.q: When I used this card's first [Auto] skill to play 《Hero》 cards that were used in a combo, they all failed to play due to a [Counter : Play] skill. In such cases, does the "when played, negate this skill for the turn" effect negate this [Auto] skill?
qa.a: No, the skill is only negated if 1 or more cards are played.

qa.q: Can you activate this card's 2nd [Auto] skill even when a ＜Hirudegarn＞ card leaves the Battle Area by this card's skill?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: Can you use Rest Mode 《Hero》 cards in combos even if this card has activated its [Auto] skill and leaves the Unison Area?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: Does your Z-Unison meet the "you have 2 or more blue cards in your Battle Area" condition for this card's [Activate : Main] skill cost?
qa.a: No. As with Unisons, Z-Unisons are placed in the Unison Area, not the Battle Area.

qa.q: Can you switch your {Hoi, Wicked Wizard} Z-Unison to Rest Mode for this card's skill cost?
qa.a: No, character names and card names are different, therefore as with Unisons, Z-Unisons don't have character names.

BT24-055.name: SS Son Goku, Beginning of a Legend

qa.q: Can this [Auto] skill activate when a Battle Card that already has [Blocker] gains [Blocker]?
qa.a: Yes, it can.

qa.q: Can you choose Z-Battle Cards when choosing Battle Cards for the skill cost of [Successor]?
qa.a: No, you can't.

qa.q: Can you choose Battle Cards with [Barrier] when choosing your opponent's Battle Cards for the skill cost of [Successor] in this card's [Permanent] skill?
qa.a: No, you can't.

qa.q: Can you choose Z-Battle Cards when choosing Battle Cards for the skill cost of [Successor]?
qa.a: No, you can't.

qa.q: Can you choose Battle Cards with [Barrier] when choosing your opponent's Battle Cards for the skill cost of [Successor] in this card's [Permanent] skill?
qa.a: No, you can't.

qa.q: This card's [Auto] skill activates at the end of a battle in which this card was attacked. Does it activate even if the attack is negated?
qa.a: Yes, it activates.

qa.q: This card's [Auto] skill activates at the end of a battle in which this card was attacked. Does it activate even if [Blocker] is used to switch the guard card from your Leader to another card?
qa.a: Yes, it activates even if the guard card is switched.

qa.q: Can a Battle Card that already has [Blocker] gain [Blocker]?
qa.a: Yes, it can. It becomes a Battle Card with two instances of [Blocker]. You can activate either instance of [Blocker] when your opponent attacks.

qa.q: If multiple Battle Cards with [Blocker] are removed from the Battle Area at the same timing, do you add the same amount of markers to this card?
qa.a: No, you don't.

qa.q: Can you declare a number that’s a negative number or a non-integer when declaring a number for this skill?
qa.a: No, you can't.

qa.q: Can you declare a number that’s a negative number or a non-integer when declaring a number for this skill?
qa.a: No, you can't.

qa.q: Can you declare a number that’s a negative number or a non-integer when declaring a number for this skill?
qa.a: No, you can't.

qa.q: Can you choose any activation order for [Offering] and the [Auto] skill when this card is played?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

BT24-138.name: SS3 Son Goku, Wrath of the Dragon

qa.q: If this card's [Activate : Battle] skill is preventing Battle Cards from being played from you and your opponent's hands, can you declare activation of a skill effect that plays a Battle Card from your hand?
qa.a: Yes, you can. However, even though you can declare activation of such a skill, the actual effect of playing the Battle Card won't resolve.

qa.q: If this card's first [Activate : Main] skill plays this card into the Battle Area, then this card's skills are negated by a skill, is this card removed from the game at the end of the turn?
qa.a: Yes. By resolving the [Activate : Main] skill, removing this card from the game at the end of the turn is finalized upon the action of playing the card.

BT25-001.name: Son Goku, Face-Off With the Great Demon King

qa.q: When your Battle Card with less than 30000 power is played, if a [Permanent] skill increases its power to 30000, does this card's 2nd [Auto] skill activate?
qa.a: Yes, it activates.

qa.q: When your Battle Card with less than 30000 power is played, if an [Auto] skill activates on play and increases its power to 30000, does this card's [Auto] skill activate?
qa.a: No. The trigger conditions aren't met, so it doesn't activate.

BT25-036.name: SS3 Gotenks, Power of the Strongest Rookie

qa.q: What happens if a non-blue Z-Extra is placed into your Battle Area when there are already multiple blue Z-Extras in your Battle Area?
qa.a: All of the existing blue Z-Extras are removed from the game, and the non-blue Z-Extra is placed into the Battle Area.

qa.q: If this card can't attack due to this card's [Auto] skill, then it becomes a Z-Leader using [Z-Awaken], can it now attack?
qa.a: Yes, it can.

BT25-039.name: Majin Buu, Absorbing the Ultimate Source of Power

qa.q: This card was attacked and you activated [Blocker]. After the target of attack is switched to this card and the battle ends, is this card removed from the game?
qa.a: No, it isn't.

BT25-053.name: Son Goku & Vegeta, Strategy From Within

qa.q: Your Leader is {BT25-037 Majin Buu, Shape-Shifter}, you activate that card's [Auto][Once per turn] skill, then it becomes a Z-Leader using [Z-Awaken]. If this card's skill is used to remove the Z-Leader later in the same turn, can that [Once per turn] skill activate again?
qa.a: Yes, it can.

qa.q: What does this card's "choose up to 1 {Vegeta, Warrior Spirit} or {Trunks, Warrior Spirit} from your Combo Area, and it can’t be removed from your Combo Area except by your skills" mean, exactly?
qa.a: At the Battle End Step, that card can't be moved to the Z-Energy Area or placed into its owner's Drop. It will remain in the Combo Area.

qa.q: When multiple cards are placed in your Drop by a keyword skill at the same time, can you draw 1 card for each card placed?
qa.a: Yes, you can. The [Auto] skill will enter a pending state once per card placed in your Drop.

qa.q: When is the timing when you can choose 《Shadow Dragon》 cards?
qa.a: At the end of your turn.

qa.q: If you use this card's [Activate] skill to reveal this card from your hand and discard 1 other card, what happens to this card?
qa.a: After the effect finishes resolving, you return it to your hand as a hidden card.

qa.q: Can you use this card's [Activate] skill to discard the card that was revealed from your hand?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

BT25-133.name: SS4 Vegeta, Wild Power of Justice

qa.q: Is the "If your Leader’s back side is a yellow ＜Gogeta : GT＞ card :" skill cost for [Energy-Exhaust], [Blocker] [Revive Blue/Green], or [Permanent]?
qa.a: It's the skill cost for [Revive Blue/Green].

qa.q: If the power of the card attacking your Leader becomes 1 due to this card's [-7] skill, can a skill later be used during that battle to increase or decrease its power?
qa.a: Yes, it can.

qa.q: If the power of the card attacking your Leader becomes 1 due to this card's [-7] skill, can a combo later be used to increase its power?
qa.a: Yes, it can.

qa.q: If the power of the card attacking your Leader becomes 1 due to this card's [-7] skill, and that card has a [Permanent] skill such as [Servant] that increases or decreases its power, what happens to its power?
qa.a: As long as the [Permanent] skill is valid, the increasing/decreasing value is applied to that card's power of 1.

qa.q: If the power would become the original power value at the end of the battle due to this card's [-7] skill, which value is referenced?
qa.a: As long as the [Permanent] skill is valid, the increasing/decreasing value is applied to that card's power of 1.

qa.q: If you use the [-7] skill during your previous turn and can't activate skills on copies of this card, can you use this card's [+2] skill?
qa.a: No, you can't.

qa.q: You played {BT11-012 SSB Gogeta, Technique Unchained} into your Battle Area and you used this card's [-7] skill during your previous turn. When your opponent attacks using {BT19-090 Broly, Bestial Rage} with 15000 power, what happens to the attacking card?
qa.a: Among the [Auto] skills whose trigger conditions are met upon the attack, {BT19-090 Broly, Bestial Rage}'s skill resolves first for the turn player, and that card gets +10000 power. Next, {BT11-012 SSB Gogeta, Technique Unchained}'s 2nd [Auto] skill resolves for you as the non-turn player, and the attacking card gets -20000 power. After that, {BT25-138 Son Goku, Accidental Wish}'s skill resolves because the conditions for resolving are met, and the attacking card's power becomes 1.

qa.q: If your Leader gains the [Permanent] skill from this card's [-7] skill, then it becomes a Z-Leader using [Z-Awaken], what happens to the [Permanent] skill gained from this card?
qa.a: The skill is lost because it becomes a different card.

qa.q: What happens if you use this card's [-7] skill and your opponent doesn't have any Battle Cards in their Drop during their next turn?
qa.a: You place 0 Battle Cards from your opponent’s Drop at the top of its owner's deck instead of your opponent drawing a card. In other words, your opponent can't draw a card by the skill of a non-Leader Card.

qa.q: If you use the [-7] skill during your previous turn and can't activate skills on copies of this card, can you use this card's [+2] skill?
qa.a: No, you can't.

qa.q: Can you use this card's [+1] skill to gain control of 1 of your opponent’s Battle Cards without choosing 1 of your Battle Cards with an energy cost of 3 or less?
qa.a: No, you can't. The skill cost includes choosing 1 of your Battle Cards with an energy cost of 3 or less, negating its skills, and your opponent gains control of it.

qa.q: If you use the [-7] skill during your previous turn and can't activate skills on copies of this card, can you use this card's [+2] skill?
qa.a: No, you can't.

qa.q: Are you affected by the "you can’t play Battle Cards until the end of your opponent’s turn" effect in this card's [-7] skill even when you don't use it to play a Battle Card from your Drop?
qa.a: Yes, you are.

qa.q: Can you use BT23-140 {Ultra Instinct Son Goku, State of the Gods} to attack BT27-008 {Piccolo Jr., Prologue} in play in the Unison Area of the owner of this card?
qa.a: No, you can't. BT27-002 {Jiren}'s [Permanent] skill doesn't affect your opponent's cards, it prevents your opponent from choosing your red Unisons with 1 power as attack targets.

qa.q: If this card's [Permanent] skill is applied when you play this card from your Z-Deck, do you have to pay its Z-Energy cost?
qa.a: Yes, you have to pay its Z-Energy cost.

qa.q: If your opponent activates this card's [Counter : Attack] skill to play this card into the Battle Area, then you use BT15-155 {Pan, Time Patrol Maiden}'s [Activate : Main] skill to gain control of this card and an [Evolve] skill places BT2-027 {Awakening Evil Majin Buu} on top of this card, is this card placed into its owner's Drop at the end of the turn?
qa.a: No, it isn't. BT2-027 {Awakening Evil Majin Buu} in the Battle Area isn't placed into its owner's Drop, either.

qa.q: If you have this card in play in your Battle Area when your opponent uses BT20-115 {SS Cumber, Battle Frenzy}'s [Activate : Battle] skill to use one of your cards other than this card in a combo in their combo area, does this card's [Auto] skill activate?
qa.a: No, it doesn't activate.

qa.q: If you have a Rest Mode Battle Card with a [Unique] skill in play in your Battle Area and that card's skills are negated, can you use that Battle Card with a [Unique] skill in a combo during the turn that this card was played?
qa.a: No, you can't.

qa.q: If you have 1 energy and 1 card in your hand, how do you process this card's 2nd [Auto] skill?
qa.a: You add 1 card from your hand to your energy in Rest Mode at the end of your turn.

qa.q: If you don't use this card's [Auto] skill to play this card from your Drop at the end of a battle in which this card was used in a combo, at the end of the turn, can you choose up to 1 of your opponent’s Battle Cards and place it at the bottom of its owner’s deck, then switch up to 1 of your blue energy to Active Mode?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: If your opponent activates BT14-027 {Teamwork of Universe 7}'s [Counter : Attack] skill when this card attacks, then this card's [Permanent] skill removes a Z-Card from the game, BT14-027 {Teamwork of Universe 7} has "[Permanent] This card's skills can't be negated in any area," but is this card's attack negated?
qa.a: No, this card's attack isn't negated. This card's [Permanent] skill doesn't negate activation of BT14-027 {Teamwork of Universe 7}, it replaces a "if this card’s attack would be negated" skill effect with a "you may choose 1 Z-Card in your Battle Area or Unison Area and remove it from the game instead" skill effect.

qa.q: If you have BT4-069 {Planet Namek} in your Battle Area, can you activate this card's [Activate : Main] skill?
qa.a: No, you can't.

qa.q: If this card's [Permanent] skill is active, can you activate BT27-061 {Kamehameha Energy Release} from your hand without paying its energy cost?
qa.a: When you activate its [Counter : Attack] skill, you can activate it without paying its energy cost. When you activate its [Activate : Battle] skill, you don't have to pay its energy cost, but you have to pay its skill cost.

qa.q: If this card is in Rest Mode when your opponent draws 1 card, does this card's [Auto] skill activate?
qa.a: Yes, it activates.

qa.q: If you activate P-150 {Dende, Astute Savior}'s [Auto] skill while your opponent has this card in play in their Battle Area in Rest Mode, you send a card from your deck to your Warp, then you add that card to your hand at the start of your next turn, does this card's [Auto] skill activate?
qa.a: No, it doesn't activate.

qa.q: If you attempt to activate this card's [Activate : Main] skill from your hand, but your Drop only has cards that would gain [Dragon Ball] in all areas through a [Permanent] skill such as the one on BT22-112 {Grandpa’s Heirloom, the Four-Star Ball}, can you play this card from your hand even when all your cards with [Dragon Ball] are removed from the game?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: If this card's [Permanent] skill KO's your Rest Mode 《Namekian》 card with a [Revive] skill instead of it being KO'd by the 1st [Auto] skill on your opponent's BT25-114 {Nuova Shenron, Blazing Blaster Meteor}, does your opponent's BT25-114 {Nuova Shenron, Blazing Blaster Meteor}, switch to Active Mode?
qa.a: No, it doesn't.

qa.q: If BT27-127 {Lord Slug, Survival Strategy} is chosen for the 1st [Activate : Main] skill on your opponent's BT14-062 {Majin Buu, Unadulterated Might}, then it's instead KO'd by this card's [Permanent] skill, can your opponent choose the [Critical] skill on BT27-127 {Lord Slug, Survival Strategy}?
qa.a: Yes, they can. BT14-062 {Majin Buu, Unadulterated Might}'s 1st [Activate : Main] skill doesn't require placing a card under that card as a condition of gaining a keyword skill.

qa.q: If you have 4 Active Mode energy, you switch 3 energy to Rest Mode, and you play BT27-073 {Garlic Jr., Confrontation} from your hand, can you use this card's [Auto] skill to play BT27-082 {Meta-Cooler, Confrontation} from your hand?
qa.a: Yes, depending on the order that you resolve each card's [Auto] skill.When you play BT27-073 {Garlic Jr., Confrontation}, this card's [Auto] skill and BT27-073 {Garlic Jr., Confrontation}’s 1st [Auto] skill will both be pending.If you activate BT27-073 {Garlic Jr., Confrontation}'s skill first and pay the skill cost, all of your energy will be in Rest Mode, therefore the conditions for this card's [Auto] skill will be met.As a result, you can play BT27-082 {Meta-Cooler, Confrontation} from your hand.

qa.q: If you activate this card's [Auto] skill when a skill that includes a marker skill cost has already activated, can you activate a skill that includes a marker skill cost an additional 2 times?
qa.a: No, you can't. You can activate such skills for a total of 2 times during the turn.

qa.q: If a marker is removed from this card during the turn when this card's [Auto] skill has activated, can this card activate a skill that includes a marker skill cost twice?
qa.a: No, it can't. When a marker is removed, the applied continuous effect is negated.

BT27-069.name: A Rocket Built For One Person

qa.q: If you have 2 green Unisons in your Drop and P-464 {Golden Frieza, Return of the Destroyer} is chosen for this card's [Z-Stack] skill, what will be the value of X in the skill cost?
qa.a: It will be 2.

qa.q: If you have a Battle Card with a [Triple Strike] skill under this card in your Battle Area, can your opponent use BT24-062 {SS Son Goku, Ground-Shaking Fury} with its skills negated to attack?
qa.a: Yes, they can.

qa.q: If you play this card from your hand, switch 1 of your yellow energy to Rest Mode for the skill cost of this card's [Auto] skill, then after resolving that skill, can you activate this card's [Auto] skill again?
qa.a: Yes, you can. If you switch energy to Rest Mode for the skill cost, the trigger conditions for this card's [Auto] skill will be met again.

BT27-092.name: Dark King Mechikabura & Supreme Kai of Time, Legion

qa.q: During the turn when this card's [Activate : Main] skill has activated, will the skill cost be (3) for the [Dark Over Realm 7] skill on BT4-105 {Temporal Darkness Demigra} in your hand?
qa.a: No, it won't.

qa.q: If you have this card under BT27-069 {A Rocket Built For One Person} in your Battle Area, BT27-069 {A Rocket Built For One Person}'s own skill removes it from the game at the end of your opponent's turn along with this card that was under it, but will this card's [Auto] skill activate?
qa.a: No, it doesn't activate.

qa.q: Can you choose this card itself for the skill cost when activating this card's [Activate : Main] skill?
qa.a: No, you can't. You won't be able to perform the "place this card under it" part of the skill cost, therefore choosing this card itself won't allow its [Activate : Main] skill to activate.

qa.q: Does this card's [Auto] skill activate when you play this card itself?
qa.a: Yes, it activates.

qa.q: If one of your Battle Cards is played into your opponent’s Battle Area by one of your skills, or if your opponent gains control of one of your Battle Cards and it's in their Battle Area, is that card considered a Battle Card whose owner is your opponent?
qa.a: No, “owner” refers to the person who constructed the deck in which a card is included. Therefore, if a Battle Card was placed in a deck by your opponent, they started the game with it, and it's in your opponent's Battle Area when it's KO'd, then this card's [Auto] skill will activate.

qa.q: Can you activate this card's [Auto] skill if the target card can't leave the Battle Area due to a skill when resolving the effect of a KO?
qa.a: No, you can't.

qa.q: If a card in a battle is switched with this card by one of your skills, this card is flipped to its back side, then your opponent's Battle Card is KO'd by this card in the battle, can you flip this card to its front side?
qa.a: Yes, you can. The attacking card is switched to this card by your skill, therefore its attack KO's your opponent's Battle Card.

qa.q: If you use this card in a combo for an attack, making it have 40000 power or more, does it gain [Critical] and [Barrier]?
qa.a: Yes, if this card has 40000 power or more upon the Damage Step when combo power is added, it gains [Critical] and [Barrier].

qa.q: If your {Krillin, Surprise Move} attacks when a skill on your opponent's BT25-076 {Situation Reversal} has caused a card to be in their Combo Area, is the combo power valid for the card in your opponent's Combo Area?

If you can't send the cards to your Warp, you can't declare to play a Battle Card.

If you then have less than the specified number of cards your Drop for the [Over Realm] skill, you can no longer pay any of the skill cost for [Over Realm], and the activation fails.

qa.q: When your opponent's life is at 4 or less, this card is being given [Double Strike] by the auto skill on {BT1-005 Furthering Destruction Champa}, and your opponent is damaged by an attack from this card, how does this card's permanent skill and [Double Strike] resolve?
qa.a:
When there are multiple substitution effects for the same event, the player affected by the effects chooses the order in which the effects apply. Here are a few ways it can play out:
Example 1) The player chooses to apply [Double Strike] first, which means two damage will be dealt to your opponent. This card's "any time this card would deal damage to your opponent, choose up to 1 card in your Drop Area and place it in your energy in Rest Mode instead" skill is applied twice.
Example 2) The player chooses to apply this card's effect first. After "choose up to 1 card in your Drop Area and place it in your energy in Rest Mode instead" is applied, [Double Strike] is applied, but since this card's "any time this card would deal damage to your opponent" skill was applied first, the substitution effect can no longer be applied off of [Double Strike].

qa.q: How come I can use the effect of {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods} and {TB1-097 Son Goku, The Awakened Power} when my opponent has {DB1-066 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} in play? How is this different from {BT1-107 Cold Bloodlust} negating their skills?
qa.a:
The [Permanent] skill of {Whis, Judge of the Gods} and {Son Goku, The Awakened Power} is only applied when in your Battle Area. This is the same as how the {BT7-119 Champa and Vados, Gracious Aid} effect that reduces combo cost is not applied unless the card is played in your Battle Area.
Because {Cold Bloodlust} negates the skills of your opponent’s Battle Card in hand before it is played, the [Permanent] skill of {Whis, Judge of the Gods} and {Son Goku, The Awakened Power} are not activated when they are played in the Battle Area. Therefore, {Cold Bloodlust} negates the skills of {Whis, Judge of the Gods} and {Son Goku, The Awakened Power}.

qa.q: How come if {DB1-066 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} is already in play, {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods} and {TB1-097 Son Goku, The Awakened Power} can activate their [Permanent] skill?
qa.a:
Cards like {Whis, Judge of the Gods} and {Son Goku, The Awakened Power} have [Permanent] skills that apply as soon as they move from your hand to your Battle Area. {King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler}’s skill works in the same way.
Therefore, {Whis, Judge of the Gods} and {Son Goku, The Awakened Power}’s skills can’t be negated at that point. If you wanted to negate skills like these, you have to negate them before the cards are played.
Reference:
Official Rules: 0-2-5: If a card effect directs a player to carry out a certain action, yet there is an active effect prohibiting that action, that effect is prioritized and the action is not conducted.

qa.q: Why can’t you use the effects of a second {DB1-066 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} when another {King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} is in play?
qa.a:
{King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} doesn’t have an effect that prevents his skills from being negated, so {King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} is different from {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods} in that 1-3-3 from the General Rules doesn’t apply to him. As such, the skills of the {King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} played first are given priority.
Reference:
Official Rules: 0-2-5: If a card effect directs a player to carry out a certain action, yet there is an active effect prohibiting that action, that effect is prioritized and the action is not conducted.

Afterwards, your opponent chooses {TB2-069 Son Goku & Uub, Seeds of the Future} and {TB2-066 Announcer, Ever-Curious} with P-162 Announcer, Witness of History}'s auto skill. How is this processed by the rules?
qa.a: {TB2-069 Son Goku & Uub, Seeds of the Future}'s power is greater than 20000, so it doesn't meet the requirements for "if the Battle Card your opponent is playing has 20000 power or less" and is thus unaffected. {TB2-066 Announcer, Ever-Curious} has 20000 power or less, so it meets the requirements, and "your opponent may place that Battle Card in their Drop Area instead of playing it. If they don't, they choose 1 of their Battle Cards and place it in its owner's Drop Area" resolves once.

qa.q: If your opponent has no Battle Cards in play, and you activate this card's [Counter] skill during Counter Window 1 in response to your opponent using a skill to play 2 Battle Cards with 20000 power or less, how is it processed by the rules?
qa.a:
When the skill playing the cards resolves and the first Battle Card is played, "your opponent may place that Battle Card in their Drop Area instead of playing it. If they don't, they choose 1 of their Battle Cards and place it in its owner's Drop Area" resolves once. This can play out in a few different ways:
1. When the first Battle Card is being played, if your opponent chooses to place the card being played in their Drop Area, the first Battle Card is placed in their Drop Area.
Then...
1-1. When the second Battle Card is being played, if your opponent chooses to place the card in their Drop Area, the second Battle Card is placed in their Drop Area.
1-2. When the second Battle Card is being played, if your opponent chooses not to place the card in their Drop Area, the second Battle Card will be played. Since they don't have any other Battle Cards in play, "if they don't, they choose 1 of their Battle Cards and place it in its owner's Drop Area" will not resolve and none of their Battle Cards will be placed in their Drop Area.
2. When the first Battle Card is being played, if your opponent doesn't choose to place the card in their Drop Area, the first Battle Card will be played. Since they don't have any other Battle Cards in play, "if they don't, they choose 1 of their Battle Cards and place it in its owner's Drop Area" will not resolve and none of their Battle Cards will be placed in their Drop Area.
2-1. When the second Battle Card is being played, if your opponent chooses to place the card in their Drop Area, the second Battle Card is placed in their Drop Area.
2-2. When the second Battle Card is being played, if your opponent doesn't choose to place the card in their Drop Area, "if they don't, they choose 1 of their Battle Cards and place it in its owner's Drop Area" will resolve, and the second Battle Card will be played.

qa.q: When using this card’s auto skill, you choose your opponent’s {BT6-107 Son Goku, the Adventure Begins} and {BT6-114 Android 8, Bonds of Friendship}. How does the game process this?

Then, this card’s auto skill causes {BT6-114 Android 8, Bonds of Friendship} to move to your Combo Area, but the master of the Battle Area prior to the card changing control becomes the master of {BT6-114 Android 8, Bonds of Friendship}’s auto skill, and activates and resolve it.
Reference:
Official Rules 9-6-9-1-2:
If an [Auto] skill triggered by the movement of a card/cards in the Battle Area/Unison Area to any other area or an [Auto] skill concerning the inter-player area movement requests information of the card, use the information of the card as it was/is in its original Battle Area/Unison Area.
2. If your opponent chooses to move {BT6-114 Android 8, Bonds of Friendship} first, when {BT6-107 Son Goku, the Adventure Begins} is removed from your opponent’s Battle Area, {BT6-114 Android 8, Bonds of Friendship} would no longer be there. qa.q: When you increase this card’s power by comboing, can you activate this card’s auto skill?
