qa.q: At the end of a turn where I activated this card’s activate skill, if the 〈Son Goku〉 and 〈Vegeta〉cards played by this card’s skill are under another card, do you still send those cards to their owner’s Drop Area?
qa.a: No, you don’t.

EX06-006.name: General Rilldo, Leader of Planet M-2

qa.q: Can you choose ＜Natt＞, ＜Bizu＞, and ＜Ribet＞ cards (one of each) that are underneath cards in your Battle Area, send them to their owners’ Drop Areas, then activate this card’s activate skill?
qa.a:
No, you can’t.
Cards under other cards are treated as part of the cards on top of them, and are each treated as a single card.

qa.q: Can you use a combination of cards from your Battle Area and hand to pay for the skill cost of this card’s activate skill?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: What happens when this card activates its activate skill during a battle?
qa.a: Resolve this card’s activate skill, place all cards in all Combo Areas in their owners’ Drop Areas, and end the battle.

qa.q: Can you activate this card’s activate skill from a Drop Area?
qa.a: No, you can’t.

qa.q: Can you activate this card's [Union-Absorb] skill by placing {EX06-20 Android Troop - 14 & 15} under this card?
qa.a: No, you can't. The card requires that you place two cards under it to activate [Union-Absorb]: one 〈Android 14〉 card and one 〈Android 15〉 card.

qa.q: Can you use this card’s activate skill to choose keyword skills on your opponent’s cards with [Barrier]?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

EX06-031.name: Supreme Kai of Time, Time Disruptor

qa.q: {EX06-31 Supreme Kai of Time, Time Disruptor}'s [Counter : Play] skill activated when you have {BT18-005 Rush Attack SSB Vegeta} in play. What happens?
qa.a: {BT18-005 Rush Attack SSB Vegeta} has [Deflect], so it isn't affected by {EX06-31 Supreme Kai of Time, Time Disruptor}'s [Counter : Play] skill.

qa.q: You played a Battle Card the turn after {EX06-31 Supreme Kai of Time, Time Disruptor}'s [Counter : Play] skill activated. What happens?
qa.a: Battle Cards are not affected by {EX06-31 Supreme Kai of Time, Time Disruptor}'s [Counter : Play] skill if they are played after that skill is resolved.

qa.q: If you have a combined total of 2 or more cards in your Leader Area and Battle Area that have [Wormhole] active, can you activate [Over Realm] and [Dark Over Realm] a total of 3 times?
qa.a: No, you can’t.

qa.q: If one of your opponent’s auto skills enters pending, do they always have to choose 1 card from their hand and send it to their Warp?
qa.a: No. Your opponent can choose to not send a card to their Warp, in which case the auto skill does not activate or resolve.

qa.q: Does this card’s permanent skill affect your opponent’s permanent skills?
qa.a: No, it doesn’t.

qa.q: When does this card’s permanent skill make your opponent send cards from their hand to their Warp? Before your opponent’s skill resolves, or after?
qa.a: They must send cards from their hand to their Warp before their skill resolves.

qa.q: If you didn’t place a card in your Drop Area with this card’s auto skill, can you draw 1 card?
qa.a: No, you can’t.

qa.q: At the end of a turn in which you activated {BT10-035 Zen-Oh, Cosmic Unison}’s [+2] skill, can you add the top 2 cards of your deck to your life with this card’s auto skill?
qa.a:
No, you can’t.
This card’s auto skill activates before the ”you can't place cards in your Energy Area for the turn” effect of {BT10-035 Zen-Oh, Cosmic Unison}’s [+2] skill ends, preventing you from adding the top 2 cards of your deck to your energy.
End Phase processing occurs in the following order:
1. “End of turn” trigger conditions occur.
2. A checkpoint occurs. After resolving all necessary processes for this checkpoint, all effects that last “until the end of the turn” or “for the turn” end for the turn player.

qa.q: If this card is my Leader Card, can I activate {BT5-023 Afterimage Technique} and {BT5-101 Time Magic}?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: You attack, and your opponent uses {BT2-064 Mafuba} in response. Can you use this card to negate your opponent’s {Mafuba}?
qa.a: No, you can’t.

qa.q: Can I use this card’s skill if the multicolor card in my energy doesn’t have blue in it?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: If this card is my Leader Card, can I activate {BT5-050 Dimension Magic} and {BT5-075 Shocking Death Ball}?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: In response to your opponent using a skill that plays a Battle Card, you activate this card during Counter Window 1. If your opponent chooses to play a Battle Card with an energy cost of 5, does this card's "choose up to 1 of your blue or green energy and switch it to Active Mode" resolve?
qa.a: No, it doesn't, as the Battle Card doesn't fulfill the "if the Battle Card being played has an energy cost of 4 or less" requirement of this card.

qa.q: In response to your opponent using a skill that plays a Battle Card from a secret area, you activate this card during Counter Window 1. If your opponent chooses to not play a Battle Card using that skill, does this card's "choose up to 1 of your blue or green energy and switch it to Active Mode" resolve?
qa.a: No, it doesn't, as the "if the Battle Card being played has an energy cost of 4 or less" requirement of this card isn't being fulfilled.

qa.q: In response to your opponent using a skill that plays a Battle Card, you activate this card during Counter Window 2. Does this card's "it is placed in its owner's Drop Area instead of being played, then choose up to 1 of your blue or green energy and switch it to Active Mode" resolve?
qa.a: No, it doesn't. The Battle Card has already been played, so the "if the Battle Card being played has an energy cost of 4 or less" requirement of this card isn’t fulfilled.

qa.q: When you activate this card’s [-2] skill, can you choose a multicolor Battle Card in your opponent’s hand with 10000 power or more?
qa.a: Yes, you can. The card text specifies “a multicolor Battle Card” (meaning ANY multicolor Battle Card).

qa.q: When {BT2-064 Mafuba} is on top of this card, you played a separate copy of {BT3-077 Evil Psyche Zamasu}. Afterwards, the {BT2-064 Mafuba} is placed in the Drop Area. You now have 2 copies of {BT3-077 Evil Psyche, Zamasu} in your Battle Area. What happens?
qa.a: You choose 1 of the copies to leave in your Battle Area, then place the other copy in its owner’s Drop Area.

qa.q: When {BT2-064 Mafuba} is on top of this card, you played a separate copy of {BT3-077 Evil Psyche Zamasu}. Afterwards, the {BT2-064 Mafuba} is placed in the Drop Area. You now have 2 copies of {BT3-077 Evil Psyche, Zamasu} in your Battle Area. What happens?
qa.a: You choose 1 of the copies to leave in your Battle Area, then place the other copy in its owner’s Drop Area.

qa.q: You play a battle card while you have a yellow Unison Card with a specified cost of 2 in play. If that Unison Card leaves your Unison Area later in the turn, can you play Battle Cards again?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: You play a battle card while you have a yellow Unison Card with a specified cost of 2 in play. If that Unison Card leaves your Unison Area later in the turn, followed by you playing another yellow Unison Card with a specified cost of 2, can you play another Battle Card that turn?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: You have a yellow Unison Card with a specified cost of 2 in play. If your opponent activates {BT6-116 Restore the Universes!}’s activate skill, can you play Battle Cards to your Battle Area?
qa.a: No, you can’t. Your opponent plays 1 Battle Card to their Battle Area, but can’t play any other cards.

qa.q: You use this card’s [-1] skill while your opponent has 2 energy. During your opponent’s turn, their energy increases, bring their total energy up to 3. Can your opponent attack with Battle Cards with energy costs of 2?
qa.a: Yes, they can.

qa.q: If this card loses a marker after activating its auto skill, does this card’s auto skill come into effect again?
qa.a: No, it doesn’t.

qa.q: Can you activate this card’s [-3] skill during your Defense Step?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: Does this card’s auto skill require you to send Battle Cards from your opponent’s Battle Area or Drop Area to their owners’ Warps?
qa.a: No, you can opt not to choose any Battle Cards.

qa.q: If you don’t send any of your opponent’s Battle Cards to their owners’ Warps with this card’s auto skill, are you required to send a card from your opponent’s life to their Warp?
qa.a: No, you can opt not to choose any life cards.

qa.q: If your Leader Card is {BT8-089 Hatchhyack, Malice Assimilated}, can you play this card?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: If your Leader Card is {BT2-001 Vegito} and you have 3 or more energy, can you play this card from your deck using {EX01-01 Comrades Combined Son Goku}’s auto skill?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: Can you use this card’s auto skill to add {EX13-27 The Agents of Destruction Strike Back} to your hand?
qa.a: Yes, you can. When a card references a card name in singular form, it applies to the plural form of that name as well.

qa.q: When {BT2-064 Mafuba} is on top of this card, you played a separate copy of {BT3-077 Evil Psyche Zamasu}. Afterwards, the {BT2-064 Mafuba} is placed in the Drop Area. You now have 2 copies of {BT3-077 Evil Psyche, Zamasu} in your Battle Area. What happens?
qa.a: You choose 1 of the copies to leave in your Battle Area, then place the other copy in its owner’s Drop Area.

qa.q: When this card is in play with its skills negated, can {EX13-26 Garlic Jr., Immortal Agent of Destruction}’s auto skill be used to play a copy of this card?
qa.a:
Yes, it can.
In that case, the copy of this card you played at the end of the turn using {EX13-26 Garlic Jr., Immortal Agent of Destruction} is considered [Unique], so you choose 1 of the copies to leave in your Battle Area, then place the other copy in its owner’s Drop Area.

qa.q: Can you use this card’s auto skill to add {EX13-27 The Agents of Destruction Strike Back} to your hand?
qa.a: Yes, you can. When a card references a card name in singular form, it applies to the plural form of that name as well.

qa.q: If you have {EX13-29 Babidi, Leader of the Agents of Destruction} in your Leader Area, can you activate this card’s [Counter : Play] skill?
qa.a: Yes, you can. When a card references a card name in singular form, it applies to the plural form of that name as well.

qa.q: If you place this card in your Drop Area to pay for the cost of this card’s activate skill, can you activate this card’s activate skill?
qa.a: No, you can’t.

EX13-023.name: Great Ape Bardock, Might of the Resistance

qa.q: When this card is in play, can you play Unison Cards?
qa.a: No, you can’t.

qa.q: You have this card in play. Can you use the [Successor] skill on the {BT9-137 Cell Xeno, Unspeakable Abomination} in your hand to place this card in its owner’s Drop Area to play {BT9-137 Cell Xeno, Unspeakable Abomination}?
qa.a:
Yes, you can.
While this card is in play, you can’t play {BT9-137 Cell Xeno, Unspeakable Abomination} using [Successor] unless you place this card in its owner’s Drop Area.

EX13-026.name: Garlic Jr., Immortal Agent of Destruction

qa.q: If you use the auto skill of Copy A of this card to play {EX13-09 Turles, Chaotic Agent of Destruction} with its skills negated, can you use the auto skill of Copy B of this card to play another {EX13-09 Turles, Chaotic Agent of Destruction} with its skills negated?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

EX13-027.name: The Agents of Destruction Strike Back

qa.q: Can you use this card’s activate skill to add {EX13-27 The Agents of Destruction Strike Back} to your hand?
qa.a: Yes, you can. When a card references a card name in singular form, it applies to the plural form of that name as well.

EX13-029.name: Majin Buu, Leader of the Agents of Destruction

qa.q: When this card is in your Leader Area, can you activate the [Counter : Play] skill of {EX13-20 Android 13, Exterminating Agent of Destruction}?
qa.a: Yes, you can. When a card references a card name in singular form, it applies to the plural form of that name as well.

qa.q: If you have {BT6-047 Babidi, Overseer of Destruction} in play, can you use this card’s activate skill to play 《Agent of Destruction》 cards with original energy costs of 3?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: If you sent this card to your Warp using this card’s [Counter : Attack] skill, can you add this card to your hand from your Warp?
qa.a: No, you can’t.

qa.q: If I activate this card’s [-3] skill and play a Unison Card from my hand, if this card is in play, does it get placed in my Drop Area from my Unison Area?
qa.a: Yes, it does.

EX14-002.name: Trunks, Power to Save the Future

qa.q: If I use this card’s auto skill to place {BT10-036 SSB Son Goku, Hope for Victory} face up, then I take damage, can I use {BT10-031 Trunks}’s permanent skill to reveal {BT10-036 SSB Son Goku, Hope for Victory} and add it to my hand?
qa.a: Yes, you can use {BT10-031 Trunks}’s [Permanent] skill to add life cards that would be placed in your Drop Area to your hand. However, the instruction requiring you to reveal an already revealed card isn't performed, and since {BT10-036 SSB Son Goku, Hope for Victory}’s [Permanent] effect requires the card to be revealed, you can’t place the card in your energy.

qa.q: If I use this card’s auto skill to place {BT10-036 SSB Son Goku, Hope for Victory} face up, then I take damage, can I use {BT10-036 SSB Son Goku, Hope for Victory}’s permanent skill to place it in my energy in Rest Mode?
qa.a: No, you can’t. {BT10-036 SSB Son Goku, Hope for Victory}’s permanent skill can only be used if it is revealed and then added to your hand. If it is face up in your life and then added to your hand, it isn’t being revealed then added to your hand, so you can’t use the skill.

qa.q: If you only have 1 copy of this card and no other cards in play in your Battle Area, can you activate the activate skill of {BT100-076 Ginyu, Backbone of the Force}?
qa.a: No, you can’t. That skill can only be activated if you have at least 1 ＜Recoome＞ card, ＜Jeice＞ card, ＜Burter＞ card, and ＜Guldo＞ card in play.

EX14-004.name: SS Son Goten & Trunks, Super Saiyan Tag Team

qa.q: Can you discard 1 copy of this card to activate {BT10-110 Gotenks, Going All-Out}’s [Union-Fusion] skill?
qa.a: No, you can’t. You must discard 1 ＜Son Goten : GT＞ card and 1 ＜Trunks : GT＞ card in order to activate that skill.

qa.q: Can you use this card’s activate skill to play a ＜Dark Broly＞ card with an energy cost of 6?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: If you activate this card’s [-2] skill during this card’s Offense Step, leaving it with 1 marker, is this card’s attack negated?
qa.a: No, it isn’t.

qa.q: If you activate this card’s [-2] skill during this card’s Offense Step, resulting in it having no markers left and being placed in its owner’s Drop Area, is this card’s attack negated?
qa.a: Yes, it is.

qa.q: Your opponent has 7 or more cards in hand when you attack one of their Battle Cards in Active Mode. If your opponent uses a [Counter : Attack] skill that causes their hand to drop to 6 cards or less, is this card’s attack negated?
qa.a: No, it’s not. The battle continues as normal.

qa.q: This card gains [Revenge] from {BT1-079 King Vegeta's Surprise Attack}. If this card’s [Revenge] KOs an opponent’s Battle Card, does this card’s first auto skill activate?
qa.a: Yes, it does.

qa.q: This card had its skills negated after being played in your energy. If you then play this card from your energy, do its skills become active again?
qa.a: Yes, they do.

qa.q: Your opponent uses {BT5-023 Afterimage Technique}’s permanent skill to activate its [Counter : Attack] skill without paying energy. Can you activate this card’s [Counter : Counter] in response to it?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: Can you activate this card’s activate skill by using its [Spirit Boost] to remove a marker from a Unison Card without a specified cost?
qa.a: No, you can’t activate the skill unless you remove a marker from a Unison Card with a specified cost.

EX18-004.name: Sword Dance of the Demon God

qa.q: Can you activate this card’s activate skill by using its [Spirit Boost] to remove a marker from a Unison Card without a specified cost?
qa.a: No, you can’t activate the skill unless you remove a marker from a Unison Card with a specified cost.

EX19-005.name: King Cold, Blessing of the Clan

qa.q: You use the [Activate : Battle] skill of {BT9-017 Cease to Exist} on a turn where you've already activated this card's auto skill. The [Activate : Battle] skill of {BT9-017 Cease to Exist} can be used without paying its energy cost, but would a red Extra Card activated after this card is activated still have its red energy cost reduced?
qa.a: No, it would not be reduced.

qa.q: You use the [Activate : Battle] skill of {BT9-017 Cease to Exist} on a turn where you've already activated this card's auto skill. The [Activate : Battle] skill of {BT9-017 Cease to Exist} can be used without paying its energy cost, but would the red energy cost of the [Activate : Battle] skill of {BT9-017 Cease to Exist} be reduced?
qa.a:
Yes, it would be reduced.
In that case, you would activate a 2 cost Extra Card without paying its energy cost.

qa.q: If this card is entering play from activating its [Counter : Attack] skill, and you have a Unison Card in play, will that card be put in the Drop Area?
qa.a: Yes, it will.

qa.q: Can you use this card's activate skill when it has 7 markers?
qa.a:
No, you can't.
Because removing 7 markers is treated by the rules as a step in paying the skill's cost, that would place this card in the Drop Area, making you unable to perform the “place it in its owner's Drop Area.” Because of that, this card requires at least 8 markers to use its activate skill.

qa.q: When using the activate skill of your {BT6-054 Cheelai and Lemo, the Kindhearted} to use the activate skill of your Extra Card with ＜＜Desire＞＞, can you place this card at the bottom of your deck using its permanent skill?
qa.a:
Yes, you can.
In that case, you will activate the Extra Card for a reduced green energy cost.

qa.q: If you activate this card's [Counter] while your opponent has 3 colors in their energy, but later they have 4 colors in their energy, how many times can they attack?
qa.a:
3 times.
The number of times your opponent can attack is based on how many colors they have in their energy at the time that this card's [Counter] is activated.

EX24-003.name: Pilaf, Guided by the Dragon Balls

qa.q: If you use this card's [Activate : Main] skill to ignore the specified costs on Z-Unisons in your Z-Deck, what is the energy cost to be paid when playing Z-Unisons?
qa.a: The energy cost is the value of X of the ignored specified cost, therefore the card's master can choose any number that is 0 or greater.

EX24-004.name: SS Son Goku, Guided by the Dragon Balls

qa.q: If activation of BT20-082 {Goku's Kamehameha Deflection}'s [Counter : Attack] skill is declared in response to an attack from this card, and this card's [Auto] skill gives it [Barrier], can it no longer be chosen for the [Counter] skill?
qa.a: No, the [Counter] skill activates first, and it's KO'd.

EX24-008.name: Oolong, Guided by the Dragon Balls

qa.q: Does this card's [Activate : Main] skill activate when this card is played into a Battle Area?
qa.a: No, it doesn't. It only activates when this card is in your hand.

EX24-009.name: Zamasu, Guided by the Dragon Balls

qa.q: If you use this card's [Activate : Main] skill to choose a Unison with a skill that includes a marker skill cost that has already activated for the turn, can that card activate the skill that includes a marker skill cost an additional 2 times?
qa.a: No, it can't. It can activate a total of 2 times for the turn.

qa.q: If the card chosen for this card's [Activate : Main] skill has a marker removed from it, can that card activate a skill that includes a marker skill twice?
qa.a: No, it can't.

EX24-013.name: Cheelai, Guided by the Dragon Balls

qa.q: Does this card's [Activate : Main] skill activate when this card is played into a Battle Area?
qa.a: No, it doesn't. It only activates when this card is in your hand.

EX24-014.name: Pan, Miracle to Save the Universe

qa.q: If you use SD17-01 {Pan, Ready to Fight Returns}'s [Auto] skill to give this card +5000 power when it's played, can you draw 1 card?
qa.a: Yes, its power will consistently be 15000 in the battle area due to the [Permanent] skill, this power value is increased by the [Auto] skill, and you can draw a card.

qa.q: If the Battle Card played by this card's [Activate : Main] skill is moved to an area other than the Battle Area at the end of the turn, is that card added to Z-Energy?
qa.a: No, it isn't.

qa.q: Does "each green Extra in your Battle Area" in this card's [Permanent] skill also include green Z-Extras in your Battle Area?
qa.a: Yes, it does.

qa.q: When choosing your 《Bardock’s Crew》 card for this card's 2nd [Activate : Main] skill, can you choose this card?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: If this card is switched to Rest Mode by this card's [Activate : Main] skill, does this card's [Auto] skill activate?
qa.a: Yes, it activates.

qa.q: Your Leader Card attacks an opponent’s Battle Card while your {P-002 Proud Spark Vados} is in play. Which cards benefit from {P-002 Proud Spark Vados}’s +5000 power boost?
qa.a: Your Leader and {P-002 Proud Spark Vados} both gain +5000 power.

qa.q: Can you opt not to choose any of your red cards with {P-003 Super Saiyan 3 Son Goku}’s auto skill?
qa.a: No, you have to choose all of your red cards.

qa.q: You played a red card after resolving the auto skill of {P-003 Super Saiyan 3 Son Goku}. Does the new red card gain the effect as well?
qa.a: No, it does not.

qa.q: At the end of your turn, can you choose not to return {P-003 Super Saiyan 3 Son Goku} to your hand?
qa.a:
No, you cannot.
You must return it to your hand.

qa.q: If you gained 3 or more energy after playing {P-004 Energy Attack Trunks}, does it gain +5000 power?
qa.a:
Yes it does.
The permanent skill of {P-004 Energy Attack Trunks} becomes valid the moment you have 3 or more cards in your Energy Area, giving it +5000 power.

qa.q: If you gain 5 or more cards in your Battle Area after playing {P-005 Light of Hope Trunks}, does it and your Leader Card gain +5000 power?
qa.a:
Yes, they do.
The permanent skill of {P-005 Light of Hope Trunks} becomes valid the moment you have 5 or more cards in your Energy Area, giving it and your Leader Card +5000 power.

qa.q: When your opponent combos for the first time during a battle with {P-007 Forceful Strike Cell}, can you choose not to place the combo card into the Drop Area?
qa.a:
No, you cannot.
{P-007 Forceful Strike Cell}’s skill automatically activates the first time the opponent combos, placing the combo card into the Drop Area.

qa.q: While in a battle against {P-007 Forceful Strike Cell}, the opponent combos with 2 or more cards simultaneously using card skills (or some other means outside regular combo procedure). In this case, which combo card do you place into the Drop Area with {P-007 Forceful Strike Cell}’s auto skill?
qa.a: You choose 1 among the multiple cards and place it into the Drop Area.

qa.q: Can you choose not to place your opponent’s combo card into the Drop Area with the {P-007 Forceful Strike Cell}’s auto skill?
qa.a: No, it automatically activates when the opponent combos.

qa.q: When playing cards with card skills, do you need to pay the energy cost of that card?
qa.a: No, you do not need to pay unless specified otherwise.

qa.q: You played {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods} due to the opponent’s {P-008 Clan of Terror Mecha Frieza} skill. In this case, if your leader is Beerus, Whis’ auto skill “[Auto] When you play this card, if your Leader Card is ＜Beerus＞, after your current turn ends, take another turn.” activates, but what actually happens when the opponent ends their turn?
qa.a:
You begin your turn
At the end of that turn, you do not take another turn.

qa.q: You use [Union-Potara] to play a card on top of a card that received +5000 power and [Double Strike] for the duration of the turn. Do these power boosts and skills transfer to the new card?
qa.a: The new card retains the +5000 power boost, but does not receive [Double Strike]. When playing cards on top of other cards, only changes to power transfer. Any skills granted to the cards placed below do not.

qa.q: Can you return Battle Cards in the opponent’s Energy Area with {P-11 The Almighty Beam Fused Zamasu}’s skill?
qa.a:
No, you cannot.
When a text plainly refers to a “Battle Card,” it means a Battle Card in the Battle Area.

P-012L.name: eap to Victory Dark Prince Vegeta

qa.q: You attacked with ｛P-012 Leap to Victory Dark Prince Vegeta｝ when you had 5 or more cards in your hand. Then, you combo-ed, decreasing the number of cards in your hand to 4 or less. In this case, is｛P-012 Leap to Victory Dark Prince Vegeta｝’s permanent skill valid?
qa.a:
Yes, it is.
Permanent skills become valid the moment their conditions are fulfilled.

qa.q: Exactly when is “At the beginning of your Main Phase?”
qa.a: Right after your Main Phase starts.

qa.q: Can you combo with a｛P-013 Hit, Conqueror of Time｝ in your Battle Area after activating ｛P-013 Hit, Conqueror of Time｝’s auto skill?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: What happens when you choose ｛P-013 Hit, Conqueror of Time｝ with {BT1-057 Broly, The Legendary Super Saiyan}’s auto skill after activating Hit’s auto skill?
qa.a: ｛P-013 Hit, Conqueror of Time｝does not leave the Battle Area due to its auto skill.

qa.q: You use [Union-Potara] to play a card on top of a card that received +5000 power and [Double Strike] for the duration of the turn. Do these power boosts and skills transfer to the new card?
qa.a: The new card retains the +5000 power boost, but does not receive [Double Strike]. When playing cards on top of other cards, only changes to power transfer. Any skills granted to the cards placed below do not.

qa.q: Can you choose which cards you place in the Drop Area from your life with ｛P-014 Bursting Energy Super Saiyan Vegito｝’s activate skill?
qa.a:
Yes, you can.
Yes, you choose without looking at the contents of the cards.

qa.q: Can you which cards you add to your hand from the damage dealt by｛P-015 Joyful Strike Goku Black Ros?｝’s auto skill?
qa.a:
Yes, you can.
When you are dealt damage, choose that many cards in your Life Area and add them to your hand.

qa.q: What does “the opponent cannot draw cards when their Leader Card activates [Awaken].” Mean?
qa.a: When the opponent activates [Awaken], they flip their leader over without drawing any cards.

qa.q: When the opponent’s {P-017Chilling Terror Android 17} is in play, can you activate your leader’s “[Awaken] You may draw 2 cards and flip this card over.” Skill?
qa.a: Yes, you can. However, you cannot draw any cards off the [Awaken] skill.

qa.q: Can you activate｛P-018 Occupation of Evil Frieza｝’s activate skill even if you don’t have a "Golden Frieza, Resurrected Terror" in your hand?
qa.a:
Yes, you can.
However, without evolving into｛P-018 Occupation of Evil Frieza｝, you cannot draw 2cards.

qa.q: I attack with {P-027 Gotenks} when I have less cards in hand than my opponent, and my opponent activates a [Counter: Attack] skill in response. If this results in me and my opponent both having the same number of cards in hand, does my opponent still have to place a card from their hand in the Drop Area from {P-027 Gotenks}’s Auto skill?
qa.a:
No, they do not have to place a card from their hand in the Drop Area.
The check on how many cards are in each player’s hand comes after the [Counter: Attack] skill activates, when {P-027 Gotenks}’s Auto skill resolves. Since both players have the same number of cards in hand at that time, the condition on the Auto skill is not met, and your opponent does not have to place a card from their hand in the Drop Area.

qa.q: Can you choose tokens with this card’s skill?
qa.a: Yes, you can. Tokens have no energy cost. So when choosing Battle Cards up to a total energy cost of 3 or less, you can choose tokens.

qa.q: Can you use this card’s auto skill to choose a〈Vegeta〉 card with an energy cost of 6 or less in your opponent’s Battle Area?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: If your Leader is {BT2-001 Fusion Warrior Super Saiyan Vegito} and there is a {BT1-033 Kind Saiyan Son Goku} in your energy, does this card’s permanent effect take effect?
qa.a: Yes, it does.

qa.q: When {BT2-064 Mafuba} is on top of this card, you played a separate copy of {BT3-077 Evil Psyche Zamasu}. Afterwards, the {BT2-064 Mafuba} is placed in the Drop Area. You now have 2 copies of {BT3-077 Evil Psyche, Zamasu} in your Battle Area. What happens?
qa.a: You choose 1 of the copies to leave in your Battle Area, then place the other copy in its owner’s Drop Area.

qa.q:
When this card is attacked by your opponent’s card, you didn’t use this card’s auto skill to choose 1 card in your hand and place it in your Drop Area, so “choose up to 1 Battle Card in your Drop Area that is both red and green, and combo with it in your Combo Area” did not resolve.
Afterwards, if this card is attacked again during the same turn, does this card’s auto skill activate again?
qa.a: No. Since it is a [Once per turn] effect, it doesn’t activate again.

qa.q: There aren’t any cards in your Drop Area and this card’s auto skill activates, placing a Battle Card that is both red and green in your Drop Area. Afterwards, can you combo with the card placed in your Drop Area by this card’s skill?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: If your Leader is {BT2-001 Fusion Warrior Super Saiyan Vegito} and there is a {BT1-033 Kind Saiyan Son Goku} in your Drop Area, can you use this card’s auto skill to combo with it?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: When {BT2-064 Mafuba} is on top of this card, you played a separate copy of {BT3-077 Evil Psyche Zamasu}. Afterwards, the {BT2-064 Mafuba} is placed in the Drop Area. You now have 2 copies of {BT3-077 Evil Psyche, Zamasu} in your Battle Area. What happens?
qa.a: You choose 1 of the copies to leave in your Battle Area, then place the other copy in its owner’s Drop Area.

qa.q:
When this card is attacked by your opponent’s card, you didn’t use this card’s auto skill to choose 1 card in your hand and place it in your Drop Area, so “choose up to 1 Battle Card in your Drop Area that is both blue and yellow, and combo with it in your Combo Area” did not resolve.
Afterwards, if this card is attacked again during the same turn, does this card’s auto skill activate again?
qa.a: No. Since it is a [Once per turn] effect, it doesn’t activate again.

qa.q: There aren’t any cards in your Drop Area and this card’s auto skill activates, placing a Battle Card that is both blue and yellow in your Drop Area. Afterwards, can you combo with the card placed in your Drop Area by this card’s skill?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: If your Leader is {BT2-001 Fusion Warrior Super Saiyan Vegito} and there is a {BT4-075 Height of Mastery Son Goku} in your Drop Area, can you use this card’s auto skill to combo with it?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: If there are 7 cards in your hand when you play this card, does this card’s auto skill make it necessary for you to place cards from your hand in your Drop Area?
qa.a: No, it doesn’t.

qa.q: This card’s energy cost has been reduced by two as a result of its permanent skill. Does this reduce its specified cost by two as well?
qa.a: No, it doesn’t.

qa.q: What happens to Battle Cards that reach zero power or below as a result of effects that reduce power?
qa.a: Battle Cards that drop to zero power are placed in the Drop Area.

qa.q: What does it mean to add cards to your energy?
qa.a: It means to place those cards face-up in your Energy Area.

qa.q: What happens when someone activates {TB3-048 Preemptive Strike} in response to this card’s activate skill?
qa.a: This card stays in the Drop Area.

qa.q: When you play a card with [Dark Over Realm], does this card’s auto skill activate?
qa.a: No, it doesn’t.

qa.q: You used this card’s auto skill to play {BT6-004 Preemptive Strike SSG Son Goku} during your turn. Does {BT6-004 Preemptive Strike SSG Son Goku}’s auto skill activate at the end of the turn?
qa.a: Yes, it does.

qa.q: What does “this card can't be KO'd” mean?
qa.a: It means the card can’t be KO’d by battle or by skills.

qa.q: You used this card’s activate skill to choose a Battle Card. Can {EX3-026 Forced Absorption Demigra}’s auto skill choose the same card?
qa.a:
Yes, it can.
However, since this card’s continuous effect is still active, the chosen card can’t be placed in a Combo Area via the effect.

qa.q: You used this card’s auto skill to send a 《World Tournament》 card from your deck to your Warp. If this card later leaves the Battle Area, does this card’s “at the start of your next turn, add that card sent to your Warp by this skill to your hand from the Warp” resolve?
qa.a:
Yes, it does.
This card’s auto skill is a continuous effect, so the “at the start of your next turn, add that card sent to your Warp by this skill to your hand from the Warp” portion of the skill will resolve even if the card is no longer in the Battle Area.

qa.q: You used this card’s auto skill to send a 《World Tournament》card from your hand to your Warp. If this card later leaves the Battle Area, does this card’s “at the start of your next turn, play the card sent to your Warp by this skill from your Warp” resolve?
qa.a:
Yes, it does.
This card’s auto skill is a continuous effect, so the “at the start of your next turn, play the card sent to your Warp by this skill from your Warp” portion of the skill will resolve even if the card is no longer in the Battle Area.

qa.q: When does this card’s auto skill place a card from your opponent’s hand on top of their deck?
qa.a: When the attacking card is switched from Active Mode to Rest Mode.

qa.q: Can you use this card’s activate skill to choose 1 《World Tournament》card from your opponent’s Battle Area and 1 《World Tournament》card from your Battle Area?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: An attacking Battle Card has an auto skill that activates by attacking. You activate {P-155 Hero's Mafuba} in response. Does the Battle Card’s auto skill activate?
qa.a: Yes, it does.

qa.q: Is a {P-155 Hero's Mafuba} in Rest Mode switched to Active Mode during its controller’s Charge Phase?
qa.a:
Yes, it is.
All Rest Mode cards in a player’s Battle Area are switched to Active Mode during their Charge Phase.

qa.q: When a {P-155 Hero's Mafuba} in Active Mode leaves the Battle Area, the card it was placed on remains. What happens to the position of this card?
qa.a:
It remains in the Battle Area in Active Mode.
When the top card from a stack of cards is removed, the remaining cards retain the position of the top card.

qa.q: When a {P-155 Hero's Mafuba} you activated is placed in the Drop Area from your opponent’s Battle Area, which player’s Drop Area is it placed in?
qa.a: It’s placed in your Drop Area.

qa.q: Your opponent attacked with a Battle Card that has 15000 power. The condition for the auto skill of the opponent’s leader, {BT01-001 Champa}, has been fulfilled, but you activated {P-155 Hero's Mafuba} before it resolved. Can your opponent draw a card with {BT01-001 Champa}’s auto skill?
qa.a:
No, they cannot.
If the attacking Battle Card does not have 15000 or more power when the skill resolves, the auto skill is not valid.

qa.q: Is a {P-155 Hero's Mafuba} on a Battle Card considered a card in the Battle Area?
qa.a: Yes, it is. The entire stack is treated as a single card.

qa.q: Can you choose a {P-155 Hero's Mafuba} on top of one of your Battle Cards as the card you place in your Drop Area with {BT1-057 Broly, The Legendary Super Saiyan}’s auto skill?
qa.a:
Yes, you can.
The entire stack of cards is placed in the Drop Area.

qa.q: If you place a {BT1-078 Overflowing Bio Warrior Army} with a {P-155 Hero's Mafuba} stacked on top of it in the Drop Area due to {BT1-057 Broly, The Legendary Super Saiyan}’s auto skill, does the Bio Warrior Army’s auto skill activate?
qa.a:
No, it does not.
As long as {P-155 Hero's Mafuba} is on a Battle Card, all information on the card is negated. It’s placed in the Drop Area as a negated card, meaning the auto skill does not activate.

qa.q: You attack with {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods}, and the opponent activates {P-155 Hero's Mafuba}. What happens?
qa.a:
The battle ends.
{BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods}’s attack is not negated, yet as {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods} has been overwritten by {P-155 Hero's Mafuba}, a Battle Card has left the battle, thus ending it.

qa.q: You attack with a Ghost Token, and your opponent activates this card in response. What happens?
qa.a: The Ghost Token’s attack is negated, and this card is placed on top of it. At the end of your next turn, this card is placed in its owner’s Drop Area. The token remains in the same position it was in when this card was placed on top of it.

qa.q: When you attacked with a Battle Card which has [Indestructible], the opponent activated {P-155 Hero's Mafuba}. In this case, what happens.
qa.a: After the Battle Card’s attack is negated, place {BT2-064 Mafuba} on the Battle Card with [Indestructible].

qa.q: Is a {P-155 Hero's Mafuba} placed on a Battle Card via its own effect treated as a card in the Battle Area?
qa.a:
Yes, it is.
All Rest Mode cards in a player’s Battle Area are switched to Active Mode during their Charge Phase.

qa.q: Can you activate and resolve this card’s activate skill if there is 1 《World Tournament》card in your opponent’s Battle Area and 1 《World Tournament》card in your Battle Area?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: If this card is your Leader Card, can you play {BT6-015 Gogeta, Unparalleled Fusion Warrior}?
qa.a:
No, you can’t.
Since this card is treated as being red, green and yellow, {BT6-015 Gogeta, Unparalleled Fusion Warrior}’s skill prevents you from playing it since this Leader isn’t “red and no other color”.

qa.q: If this card is your Leader Card, can you play {BT7-125 SS3 Nappa, Saiyan Might}?
qa.a:
No, you can’t.
Since this card is treated as being red, green and yellow, {BT7-125 SS3 Nappa, Might}’s skill prevents you from playing it since you have a non-red card in an area other than your deck, hand, or life.

qa.q: Does this card’s auto skill activate when you combo with an opponent’s red card using {BT4-106 Dark Control Demon God Demigra}’s auto skill?
qa.a: Yes, it does.

qa.q: Can you resolve this card’s “combo with this card from your Battle Area or Drop Area” skill if this card is in Rest Mode?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: If this card has its power reduced to zero or below by a skill that says “gets -X power for the duration of the turn” how is this card’s permanent skill applied?
qa.a: First, this card’s owner can choose to use “you may choose 1 multicolor card from your hand and place it in your Drop Area instead”. If they choose not to place a card in their Drop Area, this card is sent to the Drop Area. If they choose to place a card in their Drop Area, it prevents the card from being placed in the Drop Area once, but since effects that decrease power are continuous effects, the power reduction would remain and this card would be placed in the Drop Area due to the rules.

qa.q: How does this card’s permanent skill resolve if this card’s power is reduced by 25000 by a skill?
qa.a: First, when this card’s power reaches 0, it fulfills the conditions of “when this card would be removed from your Battle Area by an opponent's skill,” so the effect of “this card gets -10000 power for the duration of the turn instead” resolves. Afterwards, since the card’s power is now -10000, it’s placed in its owner’s Drop Area by rules processing.

qa.q: This card’s energy cost is 2 because of its permanent effect. When you play this card, if your opponent activates the [Counter] skill on {BT8-104 Super Kamehameha}, does its “it is sent to its owner's Warp instead of being played” skill resolve?
qa.a: Yes, it does.

qa.q: If {P-188 Frieza, Everlasting Emperor} is chosen to pay the skill cost for this card’s activate skill, but {P-188 Frieza, Everlasting Emperor} doesn’t leave the Battle Area because of its permanent skill, does this card’s “choose up to 1 《Frieza Clan》 card with an energy cost of 2 or less from your deck, play it with its skills negated for the duration of the turn, then shuffle your deck” skill resolve?
qa.a: No, it doesn’t.

qa.q: Does this card’s auto skill activate if your opponent has 5 energy, and this card is played from your hand off your opponent’s {P-008 Clan of Terror Mecha Frieza}’s auto skill?
qa.a: Yes, it does.

qa.q: If this card in a Battle Area is sent to its owner's Drop Area to pay a skill cost for a [Successor] skill, what energy cost is it treated as having?
qa.a: It is treated as having an energy cost of 4.

qa.q: If you use this card's [Permanent] skill to activate [Union-Potara] and play this card on top of {BT1-033 Kind Saiyan Son Goku} in your energy, does {BT1-033 Kind Saiyan Son Goku}'s [Auto] skill activate?
qa.a: No, it doesn't.

qa.q: If you use this card's [Permanent] skill to activate [Union-Potara] and play this card on top of a {Vegeta, Returned from Darkness} in your energy, does {Vegeta, Returned from Darkness}'s [Auto] skill activate?
qa.a: No, it doesn't.

qa.q: Your opponent activates the [Counter : Play] skill on {BT10-044 SS Trunks, God-Sealing Technique} in response to this card’s [Union-Potara] skill, causing you to return this card to your hand instead of playing it. Can you play the ＜Trunks : Xeno＞ and ＜Vegeta : Xeno＞ cards you sent to your Warp with this card’s [Union-Potara] skill?
qa.a: No, you can’t.

qa.q: Can you activate this card’s [-3] skill during your Defense Step?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: Can you use this card’s auto skill to add 1 ｛BT11-096 Son Gohan｝ and 1 ｛TB3-050 Son Gohan｝ from your deck to your hand?
qa.a: No, you can’t. While the two cards have different card numbers, making them unique from each other, they have the same card name, which means you can’t add 1 of each to your hand.

qa.q: During a battle where you activated this card’s activate skill, can you place a card from your life in your Drop Area after taking [Critical] damage?
qa.a: No, you can’t.

qa.q: During a battle where you activated this card’s activate skill, can your opponent use ｛BT9-126 Beerus, God of Destruction Returns｝’s permanent skill to add a card from their Drop Area to their energy?
qa.a: No, they can’t. In order to add a card to their energy, your opponent must deal damage to you. And this card’s activate skill prevents that.

qa.q: If you want to use this card’s permanent skill to reduce an Extra Card’s cost by (Y), what steps do you take during activation?
qa.a:
Follow the steps below during activation:
1. Reveal the Extra Card you want to activate.
2. Choose whether or not to add a card from your life to your hand using this card’s permanent skill.
3. If you added a card from your life to your hand, pay for the Extra Card you want to activate with its energy cost reduced by (Y).
If the Extra Card’s energy cost is zero or less, you don’t need to pay its energy cost.
4.The Extra Card’s skill activates.

qa.q: When you activate an Extra Card with an original energy cost of 0, can you use this card’s permanent skill to add a card from your life to your hand?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: If you activate an Extra Card from your hand, can you activate {BT7-098 Restrain} from your Drop Area during the same turn?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: You have no yellow energy in Active Mode. Can you still use this card’s permanent skill to activate {BT1-107 Cold Bloodlust} (total cost 1, specified cost Y) from your hand?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: You have no yellow energy in Active Mode. Can you still use this card’s permanent skill to activate {BT2-120 Darkness Eye Beam} (total cost 2, specified cost YY) from your hand?
qa.a: No, you can’t.

qa.q: You have no yellow energy in Active Mode. Can you still use this card’s permanent skill to activate {TB1-095 Universe 7 Representative} (total cost 1, no specified cost) from your hand?
qa.a: No, you can’t. This card’s permanent skill reduces (Y) specified costs, so you still have to pay the energy cost for {TB1-095 Universe 7 Representative}.

qa.q: When you activate an Extra Card with an original energy cost of 0, can you use this card’s permanent skill to add a card from your life to your hand?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: Can I use this card’s permanent skill to activate {TB1-095 Universe 7 Representative}?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: This card’s second permanent skill reads, ”ignore any Leader Card color requirements on 《World Tournament》 card skills.” What requirements does this let me ignore, exactly?
qa.a:
Here are a few examples of the color requirements you can ignore:
1. {TB2-008 Mighty Mask, Powers Combined}’s auto skill -- ”if your Leader Card is red”
2. {TB2-023 Pan, Proudest Daughter}’s permanent skill -- ”if your Leader Card is blue”
3. {TB2-045 Destined Conclusion Hero}’s auto skill -- ”if your Leader Card is green”

qa.q: Can I use this card’s second permanent skill to ignore {TB2-033 Shocking Latent Ability}’s ”If your Leader Card is ＜Uub＞” requirement?
qa.a: You can’t, as Extra Cards do not have special traits.

qa.q: If you use this card’s activate skill to choose {P-154 Kami, Ethereal Technique}, can you play both {TB2-039 Destined Conclusion Piccolo Jr.} and {TB2-045 Destined Conclusion Hero}?
qa.a: No, you can only play one or the other.

qa.q: Can you include more than 5 copies total of this card and {BT1-081 Broly's Ring} in your deck?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: What skill does this card’s auto skill activate?
qa.a: The card’s [Field] skill.

qa.q: When you use this card’s auto skill to activate this card, does {BT10-092 SS Gotenks, Display of Mastery}’s auto skill activate?
qa.a: Yes, it does.

qa.q: When placed sideways, is this card’s orientation treated the same as a vertical-facing card?
qa.a:
No, it varies by area:
Battle Area
Active Mode: The card is placed horizontally from your perspective.
Rest Mode: The card is placed upside down, horizontally, from your perspective.
Outside of Battle Area (Same as cards placed vertically)
Active Mode: Card is placed vertically from your perspective.
Rest Mode: Card is placed horizontally from your perspective.

qa.q: Can you include more than 5 copies total of this card and {SD9-05 King Vegeta's Dynasty} in your deck?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: When placed sideways, is this card’s orientation treated the same as a vertical-facing card?
qa.a:
No, it varies by area:
Battle Area
Active Mode: The card is placed horizontally, facing away from you.
Rest Mode: Card is placed upside down, horizontally, facing away from you.
Outside of Battle Area (Same as cards placed vertically)
Active Mode: Card is placed vertically from your perspective.
Rest Mode: Card is placed horizontally from your perspective.

qa.q: If you activate this card’s [-2] skill when it has 2 markers, can you place the chosen Battle Card in its owner’s Drop Area?
qa.a: No, it remains in the Battle Area with its skills negated for the turn.

qa.q: Can you use this card’s activate skill to choose your own 《Evil Incarnate》 Leader Card?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: When you activate this card’s [Union-Fusion] skill, can you choose 1 card each from your hand and Warp?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

P-321.name: Dark Masked King, Spirit Boost Sovereign

qa.q: Your Leader Card is {BT2-001 Fusion Warrior Super Saiyan Vegito}, and a yellow ＜Son Goku＞ card is in your Drop Area. Is this card’s energy cost reduced by 4?
qa.a: No, it’s not.

qa.q: During a turn where you activated this card’s auto skill, can you use this card’s auto skill to switch a {BT10-119 Negative Energy One-Star Ball} in your opponent’s Battle Area to Rest Mode?
qa.a: No, you can’t.

qa.q: Can you use this card’s activate skill to play a ＜Porunga＞ card from your Drop Area?
qa.a: No, you can’t. The only cards that can be played with this card’s skill are cards with ＜Shenron＞ or ＜Shenron : Br＞ in their character names.

qa.q: You use this card’s activate skill to play {EX04-04 Full Power Broly, Resonant Evolution} from your hand. Does {EX04-04 Full Power Broly, Resonant Evolution}’s permanent skill take effect?
qa.a: Yes, it does.

qa.q: Can you use this card’s activate skill to play {BT13-024 SS Broly, Brawn Amplified} from your hand?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: Which player turns over their life card first: you, or your opponent?
qa.a: The current turn player flips over their life card first.

qa.q: Is this card treated as a multicolor card?
qa.a: No, it’s not.

qa.q: You play this card, and your opponent announces they're activating {BT10-029 Pilaf Missile}’s [Counter] skill in response. If you have 2 or more energy, can you play this card?
qa.a: No, it's placed in your Drop Area instead of being played. This card’s second [Permanent] skill is only active in your Battle Area.

qa.q: You activate this card’s second [Activate : Main] skill, but don't play a ＜Dr.Uiro＞ card from your hand. Can you still resolve the rest of the effect following “If you do”?
qa.a: Yes, you can. Effects that read “if you do” following a selection of up to 1 or more cards are effectively the same as effects that read “you may”.

qa.q: When can you activate this card’s [Arrival Red/Blue/Green/Yellow] skill?
qa.a: If Battle Cards in your Combo Area have original colors that include red, blue, green, and yellow, you can activate the skill by paying its skill cost.

qa.q: You have 1 Red/Blue multicolor card and 1 Blue/Green multicolor card in your energy area, and 3 cards in your Battle Area that are red, blue, and green respectively. If this card is in your Battle Area, how much of a power boost does it get from its [Permanent] effect?
qa.a: There are a total of 3 colors among your other cards in play (red, blue, and green), and this card itself is black, giving you a total of four colors. As such, this card gets +20000 power (5,000 x 4), giving it a total power of 30,000.

qa.q: You use this card’s [Auto] skill to choose 1 of your Red/Blue multicolor cards. Which of your opponent’s cards become unable to attack your Leader Card due to this skill's effect?
qa.a: Your opponent’s Battle Cards that are Red/Blue multicolor cards can’t attack your Leader Card.

qa.q: You use a card effect to play this card during your opponent’s turn. When does the “until the end of your opponent's next turn” part of this card’s [Auto] effect end?
qa.a: At the end of your opponent’s next turn after current one.

qa.q: You play this card, and your opponent announces they're activating {BT10-029 Pilaf Missile}’s [Counter] skill in response. If you have 2 or more energy, can you play this card?
qa.a: No, it's placed in your Drop Area instead of being played. This card’s second [Permanent] skill is only active in your Battle Area.

P-379.name: King Cold, Hail to the King

qa.q: You have 1 Unison Card in both your Unison Area and Drop Area. Does this card’s energy cost in your hand become (G)(G)?
qa.a: Yes, that’s correct.

qa.q: You use this card’s second [Permanent] skill to gain [Dual Attack], then make an attack. Your opponent responds with a [Counter : Attack] skill, which they use to play a Battle Card. Does this card switch to Active Mode?
qa.a: No, it doesn’t. [Dual Attack] is an [Auto] skill, and the post-attack checkpoint for it occurs after your opponent’s [Counter : Attack] is resolved. By the time you reach the checkpoint for [Dual Attack], it’s no longer present due to your opponent having a Battle Card in play.

qa.q: This card’s skill refers to you having “4 or more colors among cards in your energy” -- what does this require, exactly?
qa.a: It requires you to have 4 or more unique colors in your energy. For example, if you have red, blue, green, and yellow cards in your energy, this would meet the requirements. Additionally, multi-color cards provide 2 unique colors.

qa.q: During your opponent's next turn after you activate this card's [Activate : Main] skill, the first time they attack with a Battle Card, the energy cost was 4 or less. Do you lose the chance to resolve the effect of this skill that negates the attack?
qa.a: No. If your opponent attacks with a Battle Card with an energy cost of 5 or more during that turn, you resolve the effect that negates the first attack.

qa.q: During your opponent's next turn after you activate this card's [Activate : Main] skill, the first time they attack with a Battle Card with an energy cost of 5 or more, your {BT10-042 Vegeta, Warrior That Crossed Time}'s [Counter : Attack] activates and you negate the attack. Do you lose the chance to resolve the effect of {P-403 Mai, Future Possibilities}'s [Activate : Main] skill that negates the attack?
qa.a: Yes, since when your opponent later attacks with a Battle Card with an energy cost of 5 or more, it is not their first card.

qa.q: If the "negate the attack at the start of the battle's Offense Step" part of this card's [Activate : Main] skill is resolved, can you activate the [Auto] skill using the "when this card attacks" of the attacking card as the trigger condition?
qa.a: Yes, you can.

qa.q: If you use this card's second [Auto] skill to combo with one of your opponent's Battle Cards and that card's "when this card is removed from your Battle Area by an opponent's skill" part meets the trigger condition for the [Auto] skill, which player is the master of that skill?
qa.a: That skill will activate with your opponent as the master.

qa.q: If you use this card's second [Auto] skill to combo with one of your opponent's Battle Cards and that card's "when this card is used in a combo" part meets the trigger condition for the [Auto] skill, which player is the master of that skill?
qa.a: That skill will activate with you as the master.

qa.q: Can you use this card's second [Auto] skill to combo with an Extra Card in your opponent's Battle Area with a [Field] skill?
qa.a: No, you can't.

qa.q: After this card's [Activate : Main] skill activates, does the power of this card increase/decrease with the effects of other cards?
qa.a: Yes, it does.

qa.q: If your Leader's back is facing up and your opponent's Leader is a Z-Leader, can you declare the activation of this card's second [Activate : Main] skill?
qa.a: No, you can't.

qa.q: Can you declare an attack while this card's [Auto] skill is activated and your opponent has 0 cards in their hand?
qa.a: No, you can't.

qa.q: You use this card's [Auto] to skill choose 1 of your opponent’s Battle Cards with an energy cost of 1. If you activate {DB2-020 Mirage Maker Shantza}'s [Activate : Main] skill during the Main Phase of your opponent's next turn, does the chosen card switch to Active Mode?
qa.a: No, it doesn't switch to Active Mode.

P-468.name: Son Goku & Vegeta, Alliance of Rivals

qa.q: What Unisons can I choose for this card’s [Activate : Main] effect?
qa.a: Unisons show X for their energy cost, but according to rule 1-2-5-3, you can choose a Unison with a specified cost of 2 or less.

qa.q: If your opponent used a [Z-Stack] skill to place a Z-Battle Card under their Leader, does this card’s [Permanent] skill reduce the energy cost of this card in your hand?
qa.a: Yes, it does.

qa.q: Your opponent’s Leader is {BT19-034 Son Gohan} and that card’s [Permanent] skill’s effect only allows your opponent to place up to 3 energy. If your opponent already has 3 energy, can you use this card’s second [Activate : Main] skill to have your opponent add 1 card from the top of their deck to their energy in Rest Mode?

qa.q: This card is under a card in a Battle Area. When the card on top of this card leaves a Battle Area and this card is sent to its owner’s Drop Area, does this card’s auto skill activate?
qa.a: No, it doesn’t.

qa.q: When {BT2-064 Mafuba} is on top of this card, you played a separate copy of {BT3-077 Evil Psyche Zamasu}. Afterwards, the {BT2-064 Mafuba} is placed in the Drop Area. You now have 2 copies of {BT3-077 Evil Psyche, Zamasu} in your Battle Area. What happens?
qa.a: You choose 1 of the copies to leave in your Battle Area, then place the other copy in its owner’s Drop Area.

qa.q: Can I play Battle Cards with 30000 or 35000 power after resolving this card’s [Auto] skill?
qa.a: No, you can’t. This card’s effects stop you from playing cards with 30000 power and 35000 power as well.
